name_en: Create organisation from the Central Coordinating Register (Brreg)
simplest_lawful_version: M0: seed legal entity and sub-unit via API (org no. mod11-validated). M1: one-shot GET of Brreg /enheter and /underenheter on create plus a manual 'refresh' call; no DAGL/REGN/REVI roles, no suggestions for AGA code or exemptions (user picks calculation code, default generelleNaeringer).
reason: Brreg API is open and cheap and byrå client onboarding needs it; for Brutto's own single company manual entry is enough. Fetching roles stores personal data with no payroll use. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Brreg lookup cut from M1: legal entity and sub-units entered by hand for 3-5 pilots.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: one sub-unit (org no., name, municipality, in-use flag). M1: a few sub-units per legal entity from Brreg with start/closure-date validation. No headcount comparison with Brreg, no 'planned employment before Brreg registration' edge case.
reason: The a-melding reports employments and AGA (arbeidsgiveravgift, employer's NI contribution) per sub-unit; no payroll without it.

name_en: AGA zone and calculation code per sub-unit
simplest_lawful_version: Zone derived from a versioned municipality-to-zone table (yearly seed file) and stored effective-dated (valid_from) on the sub-unit, not bitemporal. Manual override with mandatory reason (four-eyes LATER). Calculation code inherited from legal entity (default generelleNaeringer); per-sub-unit override in M1. No ambulating-work split, no per-employee >50 %-in-other-zone split (exclude such pilots).
reason: AGA rate follows the zone of the sub-unit; wrong zone means wrong AGA. The frozen run snapshot records the zone used, so 'as known then' needs no bitemporal model.

name_en: AGA allowance (fribeløp) and other de minimis aid
simplest_lawful_version: Pilot gate: no M1 customer in zone 1a and no sector-exempt or 'economic difficulties' customer in zones 2-5. If such a pilot is wanted, pull in only a single-entity YTD counter of AGA saved plus a manual 'other de minimis aid' amount; no group sharing.
reason: Legally required only for zone 1a and sector-exempt employers; choosing pilots outside those cases keeps it out of M0/M1.

simplest_lawful_version: Each legal entity is its own tenant/client; shared setup by copying. Group seniority for notice periods (aml. § 15-3) is an HR concern.
reason: M1 profile is one legal entity; groups add shared allowance, calendars and approvals.

simplest_lawful_version: Only if a pilot is a skattefri organisasjon (tax-exempt organisation): flag on legal entity plus choice TERSKEL / FRA_FØRSTE_KRONE for the whole year, driving the a-melding rule skattefriOrganisasjon and the NOK 10,000 per-recipient reporting threshold (accumulator owned by K2). Drop ftrl. § 23-2 AGA-exemption monitoring and register hints.
reason: Organisations are the core segment and the reporting threshold is law for them. The AGA exemption is irrelevant at 20-150 employees (wage bill far above NOK 800,000).

simplest_lawful_version: Manual 'refresh from Brreg' call in M1; nightly diff with change proposals when byrå volume grows.
reason: Register changes are rare for 3-5 pilots; manual refresh is lawful.

name_en: Structural changes: merger, demerger, transfer, municipality merger, bankruptcy
name_no: Strukturendringer: fusjon, fisjon, overdragelse, kommunesammenslåing og konkurs
simplest_lawful_version: Handle by hand: end employments with reason endringIOrganisasjonsstrukturEllerByttetJobbInternt and create new ones; municipality mergers are covered by the yearly zone table (F-ORG-03).
reason: Rare-event wizard; SD Worx-level breadth.

simplest_lawful_version: M1 uses a flat department list (F-ORG-14). Tree with history comes with the HR extension (B34) or Huma mapping.
reason: Payroll and the accounting voucher need only a department code; B42 already chose flat lists.

simplest_lawful_version: Change the department on position periods via API/MCP batch.
reason: Depends on the org tree; preview, four-eyes and bitemporal reporting are over-engineering for the segment.

simplest_lawful_version: Add with the Huma integration (location-to-sub-unit mapping) or HR employment contracts.
reason: Not used by payroll or the a-melding; the sub-unit carries the zone.

name_en: Manager line, deputy and delegation of personnel responsibility
name_no: Lederlinje, stedfortreder og delegering av personalansvar
simplest_lawful_version: M1 approval uses roles per legal entity (payroll admin + approver) in KJO/SIK, including 'no one approves a run alone'.
reason: Customer-specific approval flows (B39) and manager self-service come after MVP.

simplest_lawful_version: No type table: two fixed optional dimensions, department and project. Custom types (funder, local branch, event), hierarchy and 'required for pay type' rules LATER.
reason: Meets B35 and the voucher export; a configurable type engine is not needed for 3-5 pilots.

simplest_lawful_version: Flat lists: code, name, active/closed, external id. No parent, owner, funder attributes or 'closed after' dates.
reason: Department and project on the voucher is what pilots need.

name_en: Sync dimensions with the accounting system
simplest_lawful_version: Fetch-only from the single accounting adapter (or CSV import). Before approval, check every used code exists and is open. No master selection, no push.
reason: Prevents the accounting system rejecting the payroll voucher (R3 D-39). [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Dimension sync and cost reporting cut from M1: one flat department/project code on the employment, carried to voucher lines.

simplest_lawful_version: One department and one optional project per employment, effective-dated on the position period. No % split, no inheritance from position or org unit, no bitemporal versions.
reason: Gives correct dimensions on the voucher; % split for funded projects comes with project payroll (LATER).

simplest_lawful_version: Bundle with the timesheet module (B20) and project payroll.
reason: Needs approved hours from TID, which is after MVP.

simplest_lawful_version: Three levels: explicit on line, then the employment's department/project at end of earning period, then legal-entity default or 'unallocated' with warning. Frozen on approval (immutable runs). AGA, holiday pay and OTP follow their base lines. No mid-period line split.
reason: Accounting needs deterministic, frozen dimensions; the 6-level chain and line splitting are accounting precision, not law. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Dimension sync and cost reporting cut from M1: one flat department/project code on the employment, carried to voucher lines.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual reallocation journal in the accounting system. Model already tolerates it because postings are frozen and corrections are additive.
reason: Accounting only; no effect on a-melding, withholding or AGA.

name_en: Control and mass change of allocations
simplest_lawful_version: M1: the 'code missing or closed in accounting' check lives in F-ORG-15; mass changes via API/MCP batch.
reason: With one department/project per employment there is little to control.

simplest_lawful_version: Candidate differentiator for foundations and research institutes after MVP; until then report hours x cost from exports.
reason: Funder cost models (NFR, Horizon Europe) are unverified and not needed to run payroll.

simplest_lawful_version: One monthly calendar per legal entity: payday 1-31 (31 = last business day), weekend/holiday rule = previous business day. Extra runs are a run type in KJO, not a calendar. No 14-day/weekly, multi-entity or special June/December dates (manual payday override per period).
reason: Every run needs a payday and reporting month; the rest is breadth.

simplest_lawful_version: Generate monthly periods with earning period, payday and reporting month (= calendar month of payday). M1 adds an offset for variable data (previous month, for hourly pay). No deadline templates, cut-off feeds or notifications.
reason: The reporting-month rule follows the a-melding; deadlines are workflow.

name_en: Public holidays, bank days and normal working hours
simplest_lawful_version: Computed national holiday/bank-day calendar (no per-location calendars). Full-time hours per week as a legal-entity default (37.5) copied to new position periods and editable per employment.
reason: Needed to move the payday and to fill full-time hours per week in the a-melding (must not be 0).

simplest_lawful_version: M0: one Norwegian debit account (BBAN) with GL account, used for net pay and the separate withholding-tax payment order. M1: optional separate account for withholding/AGA; changes need a second person. No IBAN/currency, bank-API channel or agreement ids.
reason: pain.001 needs a debtor account; B12/B41: humans confirm account data.

simplest_lawful_version: No tariffs in M1. Holiday-pay scheme and full-time hours as legal-entity defaults; pay grade and pay seniority as pass-through fields (F-PER-26). Exclude state, municipal and finance main-agreement employers from pilots.
reason: Tariff libraries and pay ladders are the largest breadth item; the a-melding fields can be filled by hand.

name_en: Pension schemes and insurances linked to the company
name_no: Pensjonsordninger og forsikringer knyttet til virksomheten
simplest_lawful_version: One pension-provider org no. (pensjonsinnretning) per legal entity, reported in the a-melding. M0 if Brutto AS is OTP-obligated, otherwise M1. Insurances, group rules and validity periods LATER; membership and rates owned by PEN.
reason: OTP-obligated private employers must report the pension provider in the a-melding.

name_en: Default values and setup templates for byrå and groups
name_no: Standardverdier og oppsettsmaler for byrå og konsern
simplest_lawful_version: M1: two-level defaults implemented directly (legal-entity default, employment override, shown as 'inherited'). Generic 6-level resolver with versions and byrå templates LATER.
reason: Templates pay off with many byrå clients; 1-2 byrå with simple clients can be set up by hand.

simplest_lawful_version: Hard preconditions (active sub-unit with zone, a calendar, a bank account) are enforced when a run is created (M0). The team onboards pilots by hand/API; readiness checklist and wizard LATER.
reason: White-glove onboarding of 3-5 pilots; the wizard is UI convenience.

name_en: Person register: create and maintain a person
simplest_lawful_version: First/middle/last name, birth date (derived from ID number), employee number, source. Model allows several employments per person. No preferred name, name history, language choice or custom fields.
reason: Every payee needs a person record.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: mod11 validation, fnr/D-number distinction, field-level encryption from day one, unique per tenant. M1: identity status (unverified / verified via tax card), D-number-to-fnr change with valid_from, read-access logging, tax-card error codes to the control queue. BankID verification LATER.
reason: Mandatory identifier in the a-melding; encryption and read logging are the founder's rule (S §2 pt 6) and GDPR art. 32.

name_en: Foreign recipients without a Norwegian ID
simplest_lawful_version: One international identifier (type, country) plus name and birth date; replace with D-number on the same person when it arrives. 50 % withholding without tax card is K2.
reason: The a-melding must be filed in the month of payment even before a D-number exists; pilots may hire foreign staff.

simplest_lawful_version: Store no private postal addresses in M0/M1 (not needed for payslip, a-melding or domestic pain.001 [verify with pilot bank]). Salary visibility is limited by role (SIK). Protected-address and confidential-group handling come with addresses/HR.
reason: No stored address means nothing to protect (data minimisation, GDPR art. 5(1)(c)); the open legal question goes away for now.

name_en: Citizenship, tax residence and social-security membership
simplest_lawful_version: Pilot gate: all employees tax-resident in Norway and members of the Norwegian National Insurance (no A1/posted workers, Svalbard or >50 % work abroad). Flag exceptions by hand.
reason: Only needed for cross-border cases, which are outside the M1 profile.

simplest_lawful_version: Work e-mail, private e-mail and mobile as plain columns on the person (audit-logged). No postal addresses, channel preferences or self-service until the portal.
reason: Needed for payslip notices and contact after termination; M0 hands out payslips manually.

name_en: Personal bank account with account-number shield
simplest_lawful_version: M0: one Norwegian account per person, mod11, encrypted, versioned with valid_from, every change listed in the run's control report. M1: change confirmed by a second person, the confirmer cannot approve the first payment to it, flag changes within 30 days of last pay. BankID self-confirmation, quarantine and foreign IBAN LATER; split net pay CUT.
reason: pain.001 needs a creditor account; account-change fraud is the main payroll fraud risk (B14, F-PLA-37).

simplest_lawful_version: Next of kin: HR extension. Children: if care days (omsorgsdager) are counted in M1 (FRA), store only an entitlement number per employee and year, not child records.
reason: Not needed for payroll; child data is personal and extended rights are a special category, so minimise.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual route: end the employment, pay remaining salary and holiday pay with dedicated pay types (K2: no withholding/AGA after death) to an estate account entered by two persons.
reason: Rare at pilot scale and a lawful manual route exists; the end-reason code is still open with Skatteetaten.

name_en: Duplicate detection and merging of persons
simplest_lawful_version: Unique fnr/D-number per tenant prevents duplicates; D-number to fnr is handled in F-PER-02. Merge tooling comes with bulk imports/Huma.
reason: Volume too low in M1.

name_en: Search and selections in the person register
name_no: Avansert søk og utvalg i personalregisteret
simplest_lawful_version: List and filter by status, sub-unit and department plus free text (name, employee number); exact fnr search, logged. No 'as of date' search, saved selections or export.
reason: Basic usability at 20-150 employees; M0 uses the list API.

name_no: Historikk og innsyn for den registrerte
simplest_lawful_version: The audit log (SIK, M0) records who changed what and when; GDPR art. 15 requests are answered by a manual export via the API. Per-person timeline UI and self-service export LATER.
reason: The legal duty can be met by hand at low volume.

simplest_lawful_version: One composite API command and form: person + employment + first position period + salary agreement (+ pension membership). M0 uses the individual endpoints or import. No pre-start tax-card order, BankID onboarding link, contract tasks or candidate import.
reason: Pilots hire every month; one atomic flow avoids half-created employments.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: ordinaertArbeidsforhold only. M1: add frilanserOppdragstakerHonorarPersonerMm for fees and board fees (with ORL). Pension/other-benefits type LATER, maritime CUT. Type lives on the stable employment; a change means end + new.
reason: Mandatory a-melding field.

simplest_lawful_version: Model supports 1:n from M0. M1 handles concurrent employments in the same legal entity, with withholding computed per person and opplysningspliktig (reporting entity) in K2. No guidance UI.
reason: Common in organisations (fixed + hourly, employee + fee); tax is summed per person.

name_en: Change of sub-unit and temporary post in another sub-unit
name_no: Bytte av underenhet og vikariat i annen underenhet
simplest_lawful_version: Manual lawful route: end with endringIOrganisasjonsstrukturEllerByttetJobbInternt and create a new employment with a new ID. Design requirement now: YTD and holiday-pay bases are keyed per person + legal entity, not per employment.
reason: Rare with few sub-units; the wizard can wait if accumulators are keyed correctly from M0.

name_en: Change of legal entity and transfer of undertaking
name_no: Bytte av juridisk enhet og virksomhetsoverdragelse
simplest_lawful_version: Comes with groups (F-ORG-05).
reason: M1 is a single legal entity.

simplest_lawful_version: formForAnsettelse incl. midlertidig and midlertidigAnsattSomTilkallingsvikar; control 'employment with no pay for 2+ months' (fase1 P05 #6) to prompt ending under the 30-day rule. aml. § 14-9 deadline alerts and seasonal reuse logic LATER.
reason: Organisations use on-call and hourly staff; the a-melding needs the right form and end dates.

simplest_lawful_version: End date + reason (6-code list) + optional last working day; triggers final-settlement steps in K2 (holiday-pay payout, stop fixed lines). Notice-period calculation, work certificate and offboarding checklist LATER.
reason: Final settlement is in M1; the a-melding requires end date and reason for ordinary employments.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual flag on the person (on by default while an employment is active) that scopes tax-card requests and run inclusion. Automatic derivation from open balances and deactivation suggestions LATER.
reason: Needed once tax cards are fetched by API (M1); in M0 everyone is active.

name_en: Employment ID (arbeidsforholdId) continuity on system switch
simplest_lawful_version: Import arbeidsforholdId, start date and leave ids verbatim from the current system. M0 checks them by hand against A07 (reconciliation report) ordered in Altinn before any a-melding is sent from Brutto; M1 automates the comparison (F-PER-35, MYN). Missing or unknown values block that employment.
reason: Wrong ids create duplicate employments in a-ordningen; required for the parallel run (B16, B19).

simplest_lawful_version: Status 'erroneous' + end reason arbeidsforholdetSkulleAldriVaertRapportert; list affected a-meldinger; corrections regenerated as replacement a-melding by hand. M0: fix data and regenerate the month's XML.
reason: Corrections are routine in the a-melding; full impact analysis is LATER.

simplest_lawful_version: Effective-dated, append-only versions: valid_from/valid_to plus recorded_at/superseded_at columns; a correction adds a row. No 'as known at' query layer, no HR-registered/payroll-checked status workflow, no cut-off exception marking. The approved run's input snapshot answers 'as we knew it then' (B6, R3 D-38, fase1 D08).
reason: The a-melding sends the state per month, so effective dating is needed; full bitemporality is not.

name_en: Position %, weekly hours and working-time arrangement
name_no: Stillingsprosent, timer per uke og arbeidstidsordning
simplest_lawful_version: Store %, agreed hours/week, full-time hours/week (not 0, default 37.5) and arbeidstidsordning (default ikkeSkift); compute % from hours or the reverse; warn above 100 %. No shift length.
reason: Mandatory a-melding employment fields.

simplest_lawful_version: 7-digit code validated against a bundled SSB occupation list (refreshed yearly). No title search, suggestions or leader-code warning.
reason: Mandatory for ordinary employments; invalid codes are rejected by a-ordningen.

name_en: Last pay-change date and last position-% change date
name_no: Siste lønnsendringsdato og siste endring av stillingsprosent
simplest_lawful_version: Carry values from the previous system; derive from new versions (pay change in the salary agreement, % change in the position period); manual override with reason.
reason: A-melding employment fields; must keep the original change date on back pay.

simplest_lawful_version: Two optional pass-through fields on the position period, reported when filled (e.g. organisations following Virke HUK). No pay ladder or automatic step increases. Exclude state/municipal/finance main-agreement employers unless they fill the fields by hand.
reason: The a-melding requires the pay grade when pay is tied to a step; ladders come with tariffs (LATER).

name_en: Form of employment, probation and notice period
simplest_lawful_version: Only formForAnsettelse (5 codes). Probation, extensions and notice periods LATER (HR).
reason: formForAnsettelse is mandatory in the a-melding; the rest is HR.

simplest_lawful_version: Exclude seafarers from the segment; the code list is changing towards 2030.
reason: Outside the segment (R3 B3).

simplest_lawful_version: Use API/MCP batch updates (B41) with the normal audit log.
reason: API-first makes a dedicated mass-edit UI unnecessary until a customer asks.

simplest_lawful_version: Job title as text on the position period.
reason: Optional HR model with no payroll or a-melding use.

name_en: Job category and work of equal value
name_no: Stillingskategori og arbeid av lik verdi
simplest_lawful_version: The employer's pay-equality mapping (likestillings- og diskrimineringsloven § 26 a) can be done from a salary export; build as a RAP report with the HR extension. No gender field in M1 (open legal question).
reason: The duty lies with the employer, not the payroll system.

name_en: Ownership per attribute group (source of truth)
simplest_lawful_version: Brutto owns all fields in M1; keep a simple 'source' column on rows so ownership can move later.
reason: Only matters with a Huma/HR-master integration.

name_en: Huma as HR master: mapping of person, position and organisation
name_no: Huma som HR-master: mapping av person, stilling og organisasjon
simplest_lawful_version: If a pilot uses Huma: one-off CSV export and import (MIG). Live integration when at least two customers need it (B21 critic).
reason: Integration and mapping complexity not needed to run payroll.

name_en: Missing for payroll: data quality per employment
name_no: Mangler for lønn: datakvalitet per arbeidsforhold
simplest_lawful_version: M0: hard validation before the a-melding and payment file: valid ID, bank account, type, sub-unit, %, full-time hours, arbeidstidsordning, occupation code, formForAnsettelse, tax card present; errors block. M1: red/green list per run. Byrå cross-client view LATER.
reason: Prevents rejected a-meldinger and failed payments.

name_en: Employee overview from a-ordningen and the accounting system
simplest_lawful_version: A07 only: list A07 employments next to Brutto's, matched on fnr + arbeidsforholdId, differences flagged, fetched on demand per month. No enrichment from the accounting system, no rolling 13-month history, no match queue (manual confirmation).
reason: A07 is the truth for migration and parallel run (B37); enrichment belongs to the old read-only product.

simplest_lawful_version: Ship the 26 standard pay types (Tripletex numbering) as a reviewed, versioned seed file in the repo; M0 activates only the ~8-10 used by own payroll (fixed salary, hourly, withholding, holiday pay, EK benefit). Legal flags locked. M1: customer may override payslip text and accounts. No 'rest of catalogue'; new pay types are added by Brutto's payroll expert on request.
reason: Every line needs a pay type with a-melding code and flags; catalogue-as-code is the cheapest lawful version.

simplest_lawful_version: Keep only flags that change tax, AGA, holiday pay or a-melding: a-melding description/report object/fordel, trekkpliktig, withholding method (table/percent/none), half-tax eligible, AGA-liable + AGA type, holiday-pay basis, quantity requirement, sign, calc rule, debit/credit account, payslip text (nb). M1 adds pension basis, sick-pay basis, June exemption, earning-period requirement, car tilleggsinformasjon. Drop retro, AFP, hourly-rate basis, holiday-deduction basis, extra accumulators, languages.
reason: Without withholding method, bonus/overtime get table tax and half tax in December (R3 D-02/D-05); flags map 1:1 to mandatory a-melding fields (inngaarIGrunnlagForTrekk, utloeserArbeidsgiveravgift, fordel).

name_en: Validate flag combinations against code list
simplest_lawful_version: Replace with a CI unit test over the seed catalogue (flags vs code-list rules). Product feature only when customers may edit legal flags.
reason: Customers cannot change legal flags in M0/M1, so invalid combinations can only come from Brutto's own seed file.

simplest_lawful_version: Store a flag snapshot (JSON) and catalogue version on every calculated line. No bitemporal pay-type versions and no test-run-before-activation; catalogue changes ship as new seed-file versions.
reason: Reproducing an approved run needs the snapshot; full versioning is overhead until customers edit pay types.

name_en: Customer's own pay types with quarantine
simplest_lawful_version: M1 workaround: customer overrides text/accounts on standard pay types; any new pay type is added to the shared catalogue by Brutto's payroll expert (low volume). Self-service copies, quarantine and four-eyes release later.
reason: Manual fallback is safe for 3-5 pilots; quarantine is only needed once customers create pay types themselves.

name_en: Default posting and dimension inheritance per pay type
simplest_lawful_version: M0: one debit and one credit account per pay type from Sjur's standard (S §6 pt 27) incl. system lines (2600, 5400/2770, 5020/2940, 5405/2785, net 2930). M1: per-customer account override (REG) and dimensions inherited from the employment only (department/project), split by largest remainder.
reason: Voucher file is in the M0 definition; dimensions are needed by pilot organisations.

name_en: Pay-type templates for accounting firms and groups
simplest_lawful_version: Revisit when a byrå has >10 clients on Brutto; until then copy settings per client via API.
reason: 1-2 pilot byrå with simple clients do not need inheritance chains.

simplest_lawful_version: One static mapping table per source profile (external code -> pay type), editable via API, storing who/when confirmed; unknown code rejects the line. No quarantine, test calculation or four eyes. M0 uses Brutto pay-type numbers directly.
reason: Pilots import hours/allowances by CSV and migrate from Tripletex/ReAi; shared Tripletex numbering covers most codes.

name_en: Payslip text and language per pay type
simplest_lawful_version: Norwegian payslip text only (field on the pay type). Translations when byrå clients with non-Norwegian staff arrive.
reason: Not legally required; M1 profile is Norwegian organisations/AS.

simplest_lawful_version: Declarative rule types only: quantity x rate, fixed amount, system-calculated; percent-of-basis and overtime factor (1+p) added in M1. Rate from pay agreement or line. No formula language (B5).
reason: Needed to price fixed and hourly pay; an expression language is unjustified without tariffs.

name_en: Pay agreement with pay form and schemes
simplest_lawful_version: Per employment: pay form (monthly/hourly), monthly salary at 100 % or hourly rate, holiday-pay scheme (10.2 %/12 %), annual norm hours, valid-from; simple version history (no bitemporal). No ladder, tariff, net pay, piece rate, 14-day/weekly frequency.
reason: Source of fixed salary and hourly rate for every run.

simplest_lawful_version: Comes with the tariff epic (F-LON-19).
reason: Only relevant for KS-like/HK tariff customers; M1 has no tariff ladders.
Rare in the segment; R3 recommends leaving it out; needs gross-up solver (F-KJO-33) and unresolved PAYE/nettoloenn reporting.

name_en: Pay history and a-melding pay fields
simplest_lawful_version: Derive sisteLoennsendringsdato from the latest pay-agreement valid-from (import the date at migration). Omit loennsansiennitet/loennstrinn (tariff users only). History = list of versions via API.
reason: sisteLoennsendringsdato is reported on the employment in every a-melding.

simplest_lawful_version: Pay type + amount or quantity x rate + from/to; stops at employment end; optional pro-rata flag reusing F-KJO-08 segments. No auto-stop on leave/lay-off, no run-type filter, no bitemporal. M0: key recurring items as manual lines each month.
reason: Pilots with 20-150 staff need recurring supplements, union dues and benefits; <=10 staff in M0 can be keyed manually.

simplest_lawful_version: Covered by API/MCP batch calls (B41).
reason: Preview + four-eyes mass-change UI is SD Worx-level breadth; an agent or script covers the need.

name_en: Benefit agreements: company car, EK, housing, insurance
name_no: Fordelsavtaler: fri bil, EK, bolig, forsikring
simplest_lawful_version: Company car (list price, reg. no., first registration, own payment -> monthly benefit with the 2026 rule + bilOgBaat tilleggsinformasjon) and EK (fixed monthly amount). Housing, lodging, insurance, shares later. M0: EK as a manual natural-benefit line.
reason: Company car must be reported with tilleggsinformasjon; common among AS pilots.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual natural-benefit line (rentefordelLaan) + agreed deduction (F-TRK-24) covers the rare case.
reason: Low frequency; a normrente engine is not worth building before a customer asks.

simplest_lawful_version: First tariff epic after MVP; start with one agreement chosen by pilots (likely Virke HUK for organisations), imported as data; no shared library.
reason: M1 profile has no tariff ladders; a fixed amount per employee covers it.

simplest_lawful_version: With the tariff epic.
reason: Depends on ladders.

name_en: Tariff rule set for supplements, overtime and holiday
name_no: Tariffregelsett for tillegg, overtid og ferie
simplest_lawful_version: With tariff + time module.
reason: M1 overtime uses a fixed % per pay type; no inconvenient-hours windows (no turnus).

name_en: Pay-settlement round with budget and pot
reason: HR-module scope (B34 payroll first); salary-review tools exist in HR systems such as Huma.

simplest_lawful_version: Use a generic employee/pay export (RAP/API).
reason: A dedicated settlement workspace is HR-module scope.

name_en: Central pay increases as mass update
simplest_lawful_version: M1 workaround: batch-update pay agreements via API/CSV with valid-from + manual back-pay line.
reason: The mechanism is tariff-driven.
HR workflow, not payroll core.

simplest_lawful_version: Employer's ldl. § 26 pay-mapping duty can be met with an export/report (RAP).
reason: Not settlement-specific; the 5 % threshold is not Norwegian law (G §2.2).

name_no: Godkjenning i flere ledd og protokoll
reason: HR workflow.

simplest_lawful_version: Generic CSV/API import of pay-agreement versions (MIG) covers M1 annual raises.
reason: Ladder-specific validation belongs to the tariff epic.

simplest_lawful_version: M1 workaround: manual back-pay line with the original a-melding description (e.g. fastloenn), earning period and percentage withholding; user adds overtime/holiday-basis effects manually; control warns when a pay change is effective before the last approved run.
reason: Requires the retro engine (F-KJO-26).
HR/finance planning tool.

name_no: Melding om ny lønn til ansatt
reason: Letter can be produced outside Brutto.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: ORDINARY monthly run for one reporting entity, all employees; payout date drives reporting period, income year and AGA rate. Status DRAFT -> CALCULATED -> APPROVED/DISCARDED; post-approval tracks per B43 (payslip, payment, withholding, voucher, a-melding) as simple status rows. M1 adds EXTRA, CORRECTION and MIGRATION (imported history) and employee selection. No retro/advance/simulation types, no run calendar.
reason: Core object of payroll.

simplest_lawful_version: Payroll admin locks the basis manually by calculating and approving.
reason: Needs manager/time modules and source events; not needed without lead flows.

name_en: Receipt of pay input with idempotency
simplest_lawful_version: One API endpoint (used by UI, MCP and CSV import) for variable lines with idempotency key (source, external id, version); match on employment id; work date on each line (hours per day for hourly staff). Status only ACCEPTED/LOCKED. M1: CSV with source profile + mapping (F-LON-08), Utleggsappen through the same API, duplicate-source warning. [Utleggsappen integration is LATER; M1 takes the same lines via CSV or API.]
reason: Agents and retries (B41) need idempotency from day 1; hours per day for hourly staff are a documentation requirement (B §10.2).

name_en: Variable pay in arrears and earning period
simplest_lawful_version: Line keeps its work date; it is paid and reported in the run whose payout date it falls in; earning period sent only when the pay type requires it.
reason: Pilots pay hours/overtime one month in arrears; M0 fixed salary does not need it.

name_en: Locking of input and correction lines
simplest_lawful_version: Approval locks everything (F-KJO-25); later changes are manual lines in the next run referencing the original line with a reason. A negative correction requires a recorded written-agreement reference, otherwise it becomes a receivable (1570).
reason: aml. § 14-15 (3) and HR-2021-2532-A make unagreed deductions unlawful; late-registered unpaid leave is common.

simplest_lawful_version: A linear pure function (inputs + rule pack + engine version -> lines) implementing only the M0 steps; retro, allowances, pension and after-tax-deduction steps are empty seams filled in M1. No graph engine, no fixed-point iteration, no performance targets beyond seconds for 150 employees.
reason: Heart of the product; determinism makes øre comparison and approval-by-hash possible.

name_en: Freeze of inputs and knowledge time
simplest_lawful_version: Store a canonical JSON snapshot of every input used (employments, pay agreements, lines, tax-card versions, settings, rule-pack id) with SHA-256 per calculation version. No as-known-at query layer, no bitemporal storage (R3 D-38).
reason: Approval binds to a hash; reproduction needs frozen inputs.

simplest_lawful_version: One method per reporting entity (calendar or working days, matching the customer's previous system); segments only on start, end, position-% change and unpaid leave. M0: manual adjustment line if a mid-month change occurs.
reason: Pilots with 20-150 staff have monthly starters/leavers; own payroll likely has none in November.

name_en: Hourly rate, overtime and variable supplements
simplest_lawful_version: M0: hours x hourly rate from the pay agreement (one hourly employee). M1: overtime = hours x (annual salary / annual norm) x (1+p) with p on the pay type (min. 40 %, aml. § 10-6 (11)); bonus/commission as amount lines. No tariff rates or time windows.
reason: Hourly pay is in the M0 profile; overtime is needed by pilots.

simplest_lawful_version: Sick pay in the employer period and unpaid leave as lines: monthly staff keep salary (or sick-pay pay type); for hourly staff a helper computes the 3-month average (ftrl. § 8-28) for the user to confirm; unpaid leave deducted via F-KJO-08 segments. Refund claims/K27 manual (FRA). No lay-off (permittering) calculation, no >6G advance.
reason: Sick-leave and leave basics are in the M1 profile.

name_en: Natural benefits and withholding capped at cash
name_no: Naturalytelser og trekk begrenset til kontantbeløp
simplest_lawful_version: Natural-benefit lines add to withholding and AGA bases but not to net; withholding capped at available cash, with a blocking deviation when the cap binds (manual handling of missing withholding).
reason: The cap is a legal rule; an EK benefit is likely in own payroll.

name_en: Expenses and allowances in the run
simplest_lawful_version: Accept pre-split allowance lines (tax-free/taxable km and per diem) via API/CSV/Utleggsappen; reimbursements against receipts affect net only. No allowance engine in KJO (UTL/partner owns the split, B32). [Utleggsappen integration is LATER; M1 takes the same lines via CSV or API.]
reason: Pilots reimburse travel; tax-free allowances must still be reported.

name_en: Employer's NI contribution (AGA) per sub-unit and zone
simplest_lawful_version: M0: monthly AGA = sum of AGA-liable lines per sub-unit x zone rate from the rule pack, plus a manually entered OTP premium base if paid this month; fribeløp tracked only if the zone has one (1a). M1: several sub-units/zones, NAV-refund deduction with one method per entity, allocation to employees/dimensions by largest remainder. No ambulant-work split.
reason: AGA is in the M0 definition and must match the a-melding to the krone.

name_en: Holiday-pay accrual and AGA on accrual
simplest_lawful_version: Accrual = this run's holiday-pay basis x employee rate; AGA on accrual at the sub-unit zone; posted 5020/2940 and 5405/2785. No per-employee ledger balance.
reason: Holiday-pay accrual is part of the M0 definition (voucher).

name_no: Akkumulatorer og saldoer hittil i år
simplest_lawful_version: Compute YTD on demand as sum of approved lines (keyed by payout year) + opening balances imported from the old system (per employee: taxable gross, withholding, natural benefits, holiday-pay basis, with a 'through' date). No materialised accumulator table, no year-lock step.
reason: Payslip YTD and holiday-pay basis need Jan-Oct 2026 from the old system.

simplest_lawful_version: JSON trace per line: step, rule id, input refs, rate, formula string, intermediate values, result. No text templates.
reason: Cheap if built into the engine from the start, expensive to retrofit; essential for finding øre differences in the parallel run.

simplest_lawful_version: Lines to øre (half away from zero); net = sum of rounded lines; withholding in whole kroner (table gives kroner; percentage per a policy decided with Sjur and checked in TT02); AGA on the monthly sum per zone. Largest-remainder allocation in M1 with dimensions.
reason: a-melding requires integer withholding; øre equality with the old system depends on it.

simplest_lawful_version: One rule pack per year as a reviewed, versioned data file in the repo (G, AGA rates/fribeløp, trekkrutine constants, a-melding version) with source URL per rate; a two-person PR review (payroll + developer) replaces the signing workflow. 2027 pack needed before the January 2027 run. No proposal packs or hotfix impact reports.
reason: Rates must never be hard-coded and change at 1.1 and 1.5.

simplest_lawful_version: Draft can be recalculated any number of times; each calculation is a numbered version (needed for approval-by-hash). M1: diff vs previous version. No scenarios/simulations.
reason: Inherent to preparing a run.

name_en: Control package and deviations vs last month
name_no: Kontrollpakke og avvik mot forrige måned
simplest_lawful_version: About 10 fixed controls (net/gross vs last month, negative net, pay after end date, missing tax card, new bank account, high single amount, sick leave without refund flag, AGA per zone, OTP without premium, pay change effective before last approved run) with acknowledge/fix; thresholds fixed in code; a-melding pre-validation from MYN. M0: engine invariants block approval and the øre comparison with the old system is the control.
reason: Pilots need controls to run safely without a parallel system.
Nice-to-have on top of the trace.

simplest_lawful_version: Run totals (gross, net, withholding per payout date, AGA per zone, holiday accrual, headcount) vs last month, snapshot stored with the approval. M0 uses the journal totals (F-KJO-45). No budget or last-year comparison.
reason: Approver evidence for pilots and byrå (GRFS).

name_en: Approval with four eyes and levels
name_no: Godkjenning med fire øyne og flere ledd
simplest_lawful_version: M0: one approval by a named human, not the preparer, bound to the result hash and logged; because every team member is paid in the run, record an explicit SoD exception and send totals to the board chair (compensating control). M1: BankID step-up, 1-2 levels, approver != preparer, byrå customer approval recorded with channel + attachment. [Byrå parts are M2 (B45).]
reason: B41: a human approves and the approval locks the a-melding by hash.

simplest_lawful_version: State machine: payment file, a-melding, voucher and payslips can only be produced from an APPROVED calculation version; any input change resets approval. M1: re-fetch tax cards via API before approval and block if a newer card exists.
reason: Prevents paying or reporting unapproved numbers; cheap if designed in.

simplest_lawful_version: DB-enforced immutability after approval; store rule-pack id, engine version, input hash and result hash. M1: CI test recomputes golden/archived runs.
reason: Bookkeeping rules forbid altering posted documentation; basis for all corrections.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual back-pay line (see F-LON-29) until the tariff/retro epic.
reason: M1 has no tariff settlements; retro volume is low.
Follows F-KJO-26.

simplest_lawful_version: Correction run for an earlier month of the same year producing corrected lines that feed a replacement a-melding; overpayment recovery only with recorded repayment or written agreement, net method only (gross method later). M0: fix errors before sending, or in the next run.
reason: Pilots will need to correct submitted a-melding months (replacement duty).

simplest_lawful_version: Same pipeline with a selection; table withholding on accumulated month basis minus already withheld (F-TRK-09); separate withholding sum per payout date (F-TRK-16).
reason: Bonuses, corrections and terminations between ordinary runs.

simplest_lawful_version: Before export: discard the calculation; after approval use a correction or extra run.
reason: Rare; correction covers it.

simplest_lawful_version: Pay advances from accounting as a receivable and recover via agreed deduction (F-TRK-24) with written agreement.
reason: Open a-melding reporting question; avoid until a customer asks.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: invariant net >= 0 per person; negative net blocks approval for manual fix. M1: automatically limit holiday deduction and carry forward, residual to receivable 1570; negative withholding only as reduction of later withholding.
reason: The invariant is a legal requirement (C §2.4); automation needed by the first June.
Follows the F-LON-13 cut.

simplest_lawful_version: Final run (ordinary or extra): pro-rata salary to end date, variable pay, holiday pay (last year's remainder + this year's earned; current-year holiday pay withheld by percentage), deduction for holiday taken but not yet deducted; severance as a manual line. No loan/advance recovery automation, no YTD tax refund.
reason: In the M1 profile; ferieloven § 11 requires holiday pay at termination.

simplest_lawful_version: M1 workaround: pay type loennEtterDoedsfall (no withholding/AGA) in the catalogue, manual line, payment to the estate account; never fetch the tax card for a deceased person (TRK/MYN).
reason: Rare; a lawful manual path exists.
Rare; handled by the trustee and NAV.

simplest_lawful_version: Per employment and earning year: basis = imported opening state (with 'through' date to avoid double counting) + sum of lines with the holiday-pay flag; rate from the pay agreement. M1: stored paid/remainder per year for June payout and termination, 60+ supplement basis (6G cap on the supplement only). NAV-paid holiday pay later.
reason: Holiday-pay basis must be on the payslip (aml. § 14-15) and drives the accrual.

simplest_lawful_version: June payout (and at termination): full amount reported as feriepenger, always trekkpliktig; June exemption via F-TRK-11; 60+ supplement withheld. Must be ready by May 2027 (own payroll and pilots).
reason: Statutory payout (ferieloven § 11); first hard test is June 2027.

simplest_lawful_version: One method per entity (e.g. 12/260 per working day or 1/26 per weekday), deducted in June as negative trekkILoennForFerie with unreduced fixed salary; carried forward if not covered; hourly staff excluded. Holiday days entered manually or from FRA.
reason: Monthly-paid pilots need a correct June net.

name_en: June and December as separate run plans
name_no: Juni og desember som egne kjøreplaner
simplest_lawful_version: Rules live in F-TRK-11/12 and F-KJO-38/39; checklists and simulations later.
reason: UX on top of the rules.

simplest_lawful_version: Pulled forward from 'Etter MVP': if own payroll continues past 2026, the January 2027 run needs the 2027 rule pack + trekkrutine 2027, 2027 tax cards, YTD keyed by year (no lock step) and the 2026 holiday-pay basis closed and carried as last year's remainder. Done as data, not a ceremony.
reason: The deferral reason (first year-end Dec 2028) is obsolete after B19 (own payroll from Nov 2026). [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] The January 2027 go-live is itself the first year switch (2027 rule pack, tables, tax cards).

simplest_lawful_version: One PDF template (nb): employer name/org no., lines with pay type, quantity, rate and amount, withholding basis, table no./percentage, withholding, other deductions, net, payout date, masked account, YTD, holiday-pay basis YTD; hours per day for hourly staff. M0 delivery by download/secure channel; portal/Digipost is POR (M1).
reason: aml. § 14-15 and bokføringsforskriften § 5-6.
Support reduction, not legally required.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: store the generated PDF immutably with content hash, in Norway, 5-year retention. M1: PDF/A, encrypted-PDF channel for staff without BankID, download of last approved slips/payment file as outage fallback, delivery status sent/failed.
reason: 5-year retention (S §1 pt 1) and storage in Norway (B9).

simplest_lawful_version: Per run: journal per employee x pay type, totals per account, AGA per zone and rate, withholding per payout date, payment list (CSV + PDF, also via API). Deduction list per creditor in M1.
reason: Bookkeeping documentation (bokføringsforskriften § 3-1 nr. 9, § 5-6) and the basis for the voucher.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: one record per legal entity with valid-from: payout day, half-tax month (12), default holiday-pay scheme, pro-rata method, negative-net account. M1: holiday-deduction method, AGA refund method, protected amount, 1-2 approval levels, SoD-exception flag. Two levels only (entity -> employment); no templates, no bitemporal.
reason: Settings drive the calculation; inheritance chains are over-engineering.

simplest_lawful_version: One card per person x employer x income year, append-only versions (valid_from + recorded_at, not field-level bitemporal). Keep deduction code, form (table/percent/free card), table no., percent, months (10.5/12), free-card amount, issued date, source, registered_by. Every payroll line references the card version used. M0 = one deduction code (main employer).
reason: Withholding must follow the tax card and table/percent must be documented per employee and payout (bokforingsforskriften 5-6; skattebetalingsforskriften 5-10-20 payslip).

name_en: Tax card ordering and change polling via API
simplest_lawful_version: Order at hire, fetch on demand before calculation and before approval, order next year's cards in December. No daily polling at first. Accounting-firm bulk fetch LATER. M0 uses manual entry (F-TRK-05).
reason: Needs Maskinporten + system user (3-5 months onboarding); M0 can run on manual cards, pilots with 20-150 staff cannot reasonably.

name_en: Missing tax card and result codes
simplest_lawful_version: M0: no current card => 50 % of cash pay, no June/December relief; in Jan-Feb fall back to last year's card (skattebetalingsforskriften 5-5-1/5-5-2). M1: map the 8 API result codes to three outcomes (use card / 50 % / block with a case); kildeskatt and 'ikkeTrekkplikt' block for manual handling.
reason: The 50 % rule is statutory and is the safe default; full result-code handling only matters once the API is live.

name_en: Tax card changed during a run
simplest_lawful_version: No dedicated workflow: re-fetch before approval; a changed card forces recalculation of the draft; after approval the new card applies from the next run. Drop the 'choose between recalc and next run' dialog.
reason: Only arises with API polling; generic draft recalculation in KJO already covers it.

name_en: Manual tax card and voluntary extra withholding
simplest_lawful_version: Promote ONLY manual card entry to M0 (copied from the current payroll system, which already holds the employer's card, or ordered via Skatteetaten's portal/RF-1211). Per-run override and 'frivillig' extra withholding => LATER (employee can change own tax card at Skatteetaten instead).
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP' but manual entry is the only M0 input path before the tax-card API exists.

name_en: Main employer flag and deduction code per benefit
simplest_lawful_version: Single boolean 'main employer' on the employment (remove duplicate on D-Skattekort). Main => table, otherwise percent (5-1-4). Only codes loennFraHovedarbeidsgiver/loennFraBiarbeidsgiver; pension deduction codes LATER.
reason: Decides whether table withholding is allowed; trivial at M0/M1 scale.

simplest_lawful_version: Own Rust port in f64 with Java operation order (N13), constants per income year in the rule package; CI gate = 100 % match vs Skatteetaten's published all-tables text file + N13 vectors (incl. >200k). M0 exercises only the monthly period. Java code never in production. Fallback for M0: lookup in the text file (monthly, <=200k/month).
reason: Core legal calculation. Licence uncertainty is avoided by implementing from the published rule and public tables (aandsverkloven 14).

name_en: Percentage withholding and method per pay type
simplest_lawful_version: Pay-type flag trekkmetode in {TABLE, PERCENT, NONE}; percent = floor(floor(base) * p/100) (5-5-4, 5-10-4); store effective method on the line and show it in the run control.
reason: Without it bonuses get table withholding and are halved in December (R3 D-02).

name_en: Aggregated withholding base and multiple payouts
simplest_lawful_version: Aggregate per person x employer by construction from day 1 (M0 = one ordinary run per month, single employment). Extra runs in the same month withhold by percent (lawful choice, 5-10-1 (3)-(4)). 'Table on accumulated base minus already withheld' => LATER.
reason: Pilots will have extra runs and people with two employments; the percent route avoids accumulator complexity.

simplest_lawful_version: Track free-card amount used YTD per employer incl. holiday pay and migrated opening value; 50 % of the excess. Pull into M0 only if an own employee has a frikort.
reason: Common for students/hourly staff in organisations; one accumulator.

simplest_lawful_version: Default: holiday pay paid in the holiday year is withholding-free; optional 'one ordinary monthly salary' variant via pay-type flag for monthly paid employed the whole earning year; 21 %/12.3 % caps; part-year rule [verify]. Must be live before June 2027.
reason: Statutory (5-7-1); first relevant June 2027, after M0.

name_no: Halvt trekk i desember eller november
simplest_lawful_version: Monthly paid with 10.5-month table card: floor(table withholding/2) on lines flagged half-trekk; percent lines withheld in full; month = December by default, November selectable per employer (match current system). 14-day/weekly pay and the 5-7-2 (4) 'supplements paid with salary' nuance => M1/LATER [verify].
reason: M0's first runs are Nov/Dec 2026, so the rule applies immediately and is checked in the parallel run.

name_en: Source tax (PAYE / kildeskatt) on pay and pension
simplest_lawful_version: M1 must detect kildeskatt cards (tilleggsopplysning) and block the employee for manual handling rather than compute.
reason: Foreign workers outside pilot profile; a-melding reporting of PAYE unverified.

name_en: Svalbard, Jan Mayen, tiltakssone and seafarers
name_no: Svalbard, Jan Mayen, tiltakssonen og sjøfolk
simplest_lawful_version: Finnmark/tiltakssone tables 6300-6700 work automatically via the port; Svalbard, Jan Mayen and seafarer rules cut until a customer asks.
reason: Outside target segment (R3 (f) B3).

name_en: Withholding cap, minimum thresholds and refunds
simplest_lawful_version: M0: withholding <= cash amount, negative base => 0. Minimum thresholds are optional for the employer ('kan', 5-4-3) => CUT. Offset/refund of over-withholding via a manual correction line in M1; automation LATER.
reason: Cap is mandatory; thresholds are optional; refunds are rare.

simplest_lawful_version: Sum per payout date for a-melding (sumForskuddstrekkPerLoennsutbetalingsdato) and one payment per date due first working day after payout (skattetrekkskonto abolished 1.1.2026). M0 has one date per month; KID copied manually from Skatteetaten until MYN/BET generate it.
reason: Mandatory reporting and payment; trivial with one ordinary run per month.

simplest_lawful_version: Enable per customer after its first a-melding via Brutto's a-melding API (N26); until then the manual register (F-TRK-19); then reconcile manual vs API.
reason: API access requires the customer to have reported through Brutto; low volume.

simplest_lawful_version: Validation in the manual register: registering a samordnet order requires ending the person's old orders from its start date; hard block if both hit the same payout (N28 K32).
reason: Mixing samordnet and old orders is a known reporting error (Skatteetaten warning 24.2.2026); liability risk.

name_en: Garnishments and child support from letters (manual register)
name_no: Gamle trekk og bidrag fra brev
simplest_lawful_version: One manual register for all regimes (samordnet, old tax, old other, bidrag): person, regime, amount or percent, period, KID, account, received date, attached letter; second person confirms.
reason: Employer is liable for orders not withheld/paid (innkrevingsloven 31); pilots with 20-150 staff will have some.

simplest_lawful_version: N28 algorithm: percent of cash base K per payout; amount = remaining monthly amount; both capped at K - forskuddstrekk (>= 0); floor to kroner; no carry-forward for samordnet; old orders follow the letter.
reason: Legal duty once an order exists; small once the register exists.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: shortfall appears in the run's deviation list; user contacts the creditor manually. For samordnet orders correct a-melding reporting suffices (N28).
reason: No electronic channel; low volume.

simplest_lawful_version: One a-melding utleggstrekk entry per person x code x payout date; one payment line per person with the order's KID (samordnet) or term KID kravtype 03 (old tax); accounts 2610/2620.
reason: Mandatory reporting/payment; liability if unpaid (N29).

simplest_lawful_version: M0 only if an employee pays union dues through payroll: dues deducted from net pay, and the withholding base reduced by the deductible dues rounded up to whole kroner (skattebetalingsforskriften § 5-9-1) within the annual cap [verify 2027 cap]. Research report C #48 ('after tax') is wrong on this.
reason: Pilots expect it; tariff-based deduction (aml 14-15 (3) d); GDPR art. 9 data. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] § 5-9-1 reduces the withholding base; needed in the first live month if any employee pays dues through payroll.

name_en: Agreed deductions with prior written agreement
simplest_lawful_version: Generic post-tax deduction: type, amount per period, end date, agreement document/reference mandatory (blocks without). No principal/balance, interest or loan-benefit calculation.
reason: HR-2021-2532-A requires a specific written agreement; canteen, gift fund and advance repayment are common.

name_en: Deduction for damage caused by employee
simplest_lawful_version: If ever needed, register as an agreed deduction with the signed acknowledgment attached.
reason: Rare; covered by F-TRK-24.

simplest_lawful_version: Fixed legal order in code (forskuddstrekk -> garnishments -> union dues -> agreed deductions by priority); never negative net. Drop customer-configurable order (D-Lonnsinnstillinger.trekkrekkefolge). Note: employee pension share is pre-tax, not a queue item.
reason: Needed when several deductions meet a low net; configurability is SD Worx-level.

simplest_lawful_version: One protected amount per employee (default from employer setting = single-person subsistence rate) applied only to agreed/damage deductions (c, e, f); no family/child-rate calculator. Garnishments have none at the employer.
reason: Required by aml 14-15 (4) for agreed deductions; no statutory rate exists.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: agreed deductions use fixed amount + end date; shortfalls show in the deviation list; migrated loans/advances become amount + end date. Balance accumulator later.
reason: Samordnet orders have no balance (N28); fixed instalments cover pilot needs.

simplest_lawful_version: Minimal scheme: provider name, pensjonsinnretning org.no., agreement no., type (OTP contribution only), employee share %, valid from/to. Drop rate steps, salary concept, G-basis, annual-salary method, membership rules, reporting form/frequency.
reason: Needed for a-melding pensjonsinnretning and AGA on premium; Brutto itself is likely OTP-obliged.

name_en: OTP obligation and minimum requirement check
simplest_lawful_version: M1 only blocks/warns when an employer marked OTP-obliged lacks a scheme/pensjonsinnretning (part of F-PEN-10).
reason: Advisory control; compliance owned by customer and supplier.

simplest_lawful_version: Boolean 'pensionable' on the pay type (not ALWAYS/MAYBE/NEVER plus per-scheme selections); monthly base capped at 12G/12; used only for employee share and AGA zone split. M0 only if own scheme has an employee share.
reason: Premium comes from the invoice; the base only drives employee share and AGA split.

simplest_lawful_version: All employees of an employer with a scheme are members from employment start unless an exclusion date is set; no versioned membership with registration time; suppliers enrol from a-melding.
reason: Determines who pays the employee share; membership history is the supplier's job.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual entry per term: AGA-liable employer premium, employee share (for 2690 reconciliation), payment date, optional admin-fee note. Accounting adapter/EHF/supplier feed LATER.
reason: Without premium input AGA is under-reported every term for every OTP customer (R3 D-01).

simplest_lawful_version: Compute AGA base from entered premium and add arbeidsgiveravgift.tilskuddOgPremieTilPensjon for the reporting month. M0: one sub-unit/zone. M1: split across sub-units pro rata to pensionable base (largest remainder). Timing and admin-fee inclusion per accountant [verify].
reason: AGA on employer-paid pension premium is mandatory.

simplest_lawful_version: Not built; premium comes from the invoice (S 6 pkt. 29).
reason: Duplicates supplier calculation and conflicts with founder decision.

simplest_lawful_version: Later control: invoice vs expected premium per scheme/term.
reason: Nice-to-have; needs rate steps and supplier detail (KLP-driven).

name_en: Employee pension share deducted before tax
simplest_lawful_version: Percent of monthly pensionable base, validated <= 4 % and <= employer share, capped at 12G/12; reduces withholding base; a-melding fradrag 'premieTilPensjonsordninger'. M0 if own scheme has an employee share.
reason: Statutory treatment wherever the scheme has an employee share (aml 14-15 (3) b).

simplest_lawful_version: Take org.no. from the scheme; block a-melding generation if an OTP-flagged employer lacks it.
reason: Mandatory for OTP-obliged private employers since 2021; missing gives an a-melding deviation.

name_en: KLP payroll file and change messages
simplest_lawful_version: Build when the first KLP customer signs; choose M1 pilots without KLP/HUK.
reason: M1 profile is contribution-based OTP; file format unmapped.
Government sector outside target; requires SPK approval of the payroll system.

simplest_lawful_version: Providers read the a-melding; build a file only if a paying customer's provider requires it.
reason: Formats unmapped; a-melding covers major providers.

simplest_lawful_version: Fellesordningen bills from a-melding data; if AFP premium needs AGA handling, reuse manual premium entry with type AFP [verify].
reason: Tied to tariff-bound employers, outside M1 profile.

simplest_lawful_version: Taxable part handled as a benefit pay type (F-PEN-16).
reason: HR/broker territory; no payroll effect beyond the benefit line.

simplest_lawful_version: Standard benefit pay type 'skattepliktigDelForsikringer' (natural benefit: withholding + AGA, no net effect) as a recurring fixed line per employee; no D-Forsikring entity. M0 if own company pays group life/health insurance.
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP' but organisations commonly pay group life/health insurance, taxable from the first krone unless treated as a gift <= 5,000 (N13 3.2).

simplest_lawful_version: Manual/HR checklist.
reason: No payroll effect.

simplest_lawful_version: Register as an agreed deduction (F-TRK-24).
reason: Covered by the generic agreed deduction.

simplest_lawful_version: Import-only register: approved absences from CSV (Huma only if a pilot needs it, FL11); one source per customer; append-only revisions with registered-at instead of a full bitemporal model; no self-service statuses (wished/applied). M0: no absence data - manual line or fall back to old system (B19 parallel run).
reason: Unpaid leave, permittering, hourly AGP pay, parental leave and a-melding permisjon all need one fact store; self-service and multi-source logic can wait.

simplest_lawful_version: Fixed built-in list of ~10 standard types as code constants (holiday, self-certified sick, sick note, sick child, parental, unpaid leave, paid welfare, permittering, military, other paid); each with pay effect, holiday-pay accrual, counts-in-AGP, a-melding description, health flag. No customer-defined types.
reason: Pay effect and a-melding description must be deterministic; a customer-configurable 24-field catalogue is SD Worx breadth.

name_en: Intake of absence from external sources
name_no: Mottak av fravær fra ekstern kilde
simplest_lawful_version: Generic CSV template with preview, file hash and per-line idempotency. Huma webhooks only if a pilot uses Huma (then F-FRA-41 becomes M1). Planday, Quinyx and NAV later.
reason: B42: absence from file or Huma in the MVP; CSV is the cheapest lawful path and avoids the Huma no-retry risk (D-41).

name_en: Switching between own absence module and Huma or another source
name_no: Bytte mellom egen fraværsmodul og Huma eller annen kilde
reason: M1 has one source per data type; needed only when the own absence module ships (B20).

simplest_lawful_version: One role 'payroll - health' gates absence type, sick-pay lines, K27 lines and sick cases; others see masked lines; reads go to the general audit log (F-SIK-08). Never store diagnosis or health free text. M0 stores no absence data.
reason: GDPR art. 9 applies from the first pilot with sick leave; cannot be cut.

name_en: Correction of absence after a locked period
name_no: Korrigering av fravær etter låst periode
simplest_lawful_version: Payroll admin enters the correction as a delta line in the next run with the original period; a negative net effect is held (REQUIRES_WRITTEN_AGREEMENT). No automatic recomputation of past periods.
reason: Late sick notes are routine; the aml. § 14-15 guard is a legal must, the automatic diff is not.

name_en: Import of opening balances and ongoing absences
name_no: Import av inngående saldoer og pågående fravær
simplest_lawful_version: M1: import as state per date: open permisjon/permittering IDs and ongoing sick cases with AGP dates; last 3 months' income via the year-to-date import. No holiday-days balance (ledger is LATER), no egenmelding counts, care days, 48-day counter or permittering weeks. M0: ongoing leave/permittering at cutover imported with the old leave IDs (PLAN §1.4).
reason: Pilots start mid-year; without open leave IDs and AGP state, a-melding and AGP pay go wrong (R3 D-07, GC-01).

simplest_lawful_version: Two settings per employer with employment override: entitlement (4 weeks + 1 day or 5 weeks) and ferietrekk method/timing; 60+ week derived from birth date. Holiday pay rate stays in KJO (M0 needs only that rate). No tariff profiles, hours-based holiday, or stored statutory constants. [M1: ferietrekk method and holiday-pay rate only; no days ledger.]
reason: Ferieloven § 5 entitlement is needed for ferietrekk and termination; the 21-field profile is over-engineered.

simplest_lawful_version: Holiday days only: append-only transactions (entitlement, taken from imported absence, deducted by payroll, carried over, manual adjustment) per employment and holiday year; balance is a computed view; fixed consumption order carried -> statutory -> agreed 5th week. No egenmelding, care-day, time-bank or flex accounts.
reason: Ferietrekk and the termination settlement need 'taken vs deducted' (C §3.4); the generic multi-account ledger is not needed yet. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Holiday-days ledger is absence-module work (B20); ferietrekk needs only the method setting.
Self-service module (B20); in M1 holiday arrives approved via CSV or the HR system.

name_en: Holiday planning, main holiday and notifications
reason: Manager/HR planning with no payroll effect; HR tools (Huma) cover it.

name_en: Changing set holiday and sickness during holiday
name_no: Endring av fastsatt ferie og syk i ferien
simplest_lawful_version: M1 workaround: manual ledger transaction that returns days (ferieloven § 9).
reason: Rare at pilot size; a manual transaction is lawful.

simplest_lawful_version: Automated year-end job LATER. Before the first year-end in Brutto (31.12.2027, own payroll) and for pilots: manual carry-over/forfeit transactions referencing the written agreement.
reason: Runs once a year at low volume; manual transactions suffice the first time.

simplest_lawful_version: One method per employer; timing 'collected in June' as default plus at termination; 'when taken' only if a pilot requires it. Merge with F-KJO-39. M0: confirm own company deducts in June so November has no ferietrekk (else one manual negative line).
reason: Needed for monthly-paid by June 2027 and in every termination; not needed in a November M0 run.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: holiday settlement on termination as lines the payroll admin enters from the employer's holiday record (no days ledger in Brutto); advance-holiday deduction only with a recorded written-agreement flag. Merge with F-KJO-34.
reason: Termination settlement is M1; ferieloven and aml. § 14-15 apply.
Year-end accounting report; can be a ledger export before the first pilot year-end.
No pay effect; belongs to the absence module (B20) or the HR system.
Employer policy for the absence module; no payroll effect.

name_en: Notice and flow to revoke the self-certification right
name_no: Varsel og flyt for å frata egenmeldingsretten
reason: HR case process (ftrl. § 8-27), never automatic; belongs to HR tools/HEL.

name_en: Sick notes and sick-pay applications from the NAV API
reason: Needs Maskinporten and the special-category access package; M1 uses NAV's portal and manual sick-case dates.

simplest_lawful_version: Sick case with AGP start/end entered by payroll (from NAV's request) or confirmed from a simple computed suggestion (16 calendar days, merge gaps under 16 days); shows first refund day and the 3-month claim deadline. No NAV sync or overlap clipping; warning only if employment is under 4 weeks.
reason: Needed for hourly AGP pay and the refund deadline list; the full state machine with NAV clipping rules is LATER.

name_en: Pay during the employer period and sick-pay basis
simplest_lawful_version: Monthly-paid: salary continues unchanged. Hourly-paid: Brutto shows the § 8-28 average of the last 3 calendar months from its own history/imported YTD; payroll admin enters the AGP pay line. No change-reason engine, no NAV income API.
reason: Ftrl. §§ 8-19 and 8-28: the employer must pay AGP correctly; M1 pilots have hourly staff.

name_no: Forespørsel om inntektsmelding: kontroll og grunnlag
simplest_lawful_version: M1: printable basis per sick case (AGP periods, 3-month average for hourly staff) for manual entry of the inntektsmelding in NAV's portal. No NAV API.
reason: Inntektsmelding via NAV's portal is lawful (R3 b.2.1); the API needs Maskinporten and NAV onboarding. [Plan v1 review fix 29.10.2026.] Cheap, and M1 has sick-leave basics.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: default 'continue salary' needs no calculation; 'stop salary' is handled as unpaid absence (F-FRA-34). Expected-refund calculation (6G, 260 divisor) comes later.
reason: Refund is claimed in NAV's portal; with AGA method 'on receipt' expected amounts are not needed.

name_en: Refund ledger and reconciliation against K27
simplest_lawful_version: M1: refund receivable per sick case entered by hand from NAV payment info; one AGA method (deduct when received); list of cases near the 3-month refund deadline. K27 import LATER.
reason: K27 drives the AGA deduction (method 'on receipt') and is the cheapest guard against lost refunds; a full ledger is not needed at 20-150 employees. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] K27 import LATER.

simplest_lawful_version: One method for all M1 customers: reduce the AGA base in the month the NAV refund is received, documented by the refund receivable entered by hand from NAV's payment information (K27 import is LATER). No 'advance month' method, no switching. Migration guard: refunds for periods the old system already deducted are marked excluded.
reason: A single method prevents double deduction by construction (R3 D-08, GC-18); founder must confirm the default.

name_en: Holiday pay on sick pay and parental benefit
simplest_lawful_version: M1: only FULL (employer pays holiday pay on all advanced salary), so no 48-day accumulator.
reason: FULL is lawful and needs no extra state; BEGRENSET and June K27 matching are optimisations.

name_en: Long-term sick leave as leave in the a-melding
name_no: Langvarig sykefravær som permisjon i a-meldingen
simplest_lawful_version: M1: payroll creates the leave record manually after 12 months (F-FRA-37); warning from the sick-case list.
reason: Rare at pilot size; the reporting rule is met manually.
Salary continues; quota tracking has no payroll effect.

name_no: Arbeidsgivers 10 dager og refusjon av omsorgspenger
reason: Refund is claimed via NAV; manual.

name_en: Care of relatives, pleiepenger and opplæringspenger
name_no: Pleie av nærstående, pleiepenger og opplæringspenger
simplest_lawful_version: Leave over 14 days is reported through the generic F-FRA-37.
reason: Counters belong to the absence module.
Self-service module (B20).

simplest_lawful_version: M1: parental leave is an absence record with % and paid/unpaid; pay effect via F-FRA-34, a-melding via F-FRA-37, refund via NAV's portal; a checklist warns about salary paid without a refund claim.
reason: The refund plan is a control, not a legal requirement.

simplest_lawful_version: Proportional deduction using KJO's single method (workdays from the national calendar x position %); no holiday-pay accrual on the deducted amount; warning for over 14 days (sick-pay re-qualification).
reason: Common pay effect for pilots; also used for 'stop salary' after AGP and for permittering.
HR eligibility check; the a-melding description is covered by F-FRA-37.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: payroll enters permittering fields (notice date, start, %, end of wage obligation, reason) manually via F-FRA-37; deduction via F-FRA-34. Counters (15 days, 26 weeks in 18 months), letters and NAV checklist later.
reason: Rare for organisations; reporting is the legal must, counting is not.

name_en: Leave and permittering in the a-melding
simplest_lawful_version: Records created manually or from imported absence; ID lifecycle (new ID on % change, end date, 0% correction, continue IDs from the previous system); store the new permittering fields from day one. M0 only if A07 shows an ongoing leave for own employees.
reason: Legal reporting duty: leave over 14 days and all permittering, every month while ongoing.

simplest_lawful_version: ICS subscription cut.
reason: Self-service UI (B20).

name_en: Absence calendar for manager and team
simplest_lawful_version: Minimum-staffing warnings cut.
reason: Manager self-service (LED).
Reporting; a simple sick-leave % from the register when the absence module exists.

simplest_lawful_version: Becomes M1 if a pilot uses Huma webhooks as absence source (FL11).
reason: With CSV import the preview count is the reconciliation.

name_en: One approval model for own and external sources
name_no: Én godkjenningsmodell for egne og eksterne kilder
simplest_lawful_version: M1: imported batches carry approvedBy/approvedAt from the source plus the importing user; design D-Godkjenning now, build with the modules.
reason: Everything arrives approved in M1; the payroll-run approval sits in KJO.
Needed only with own modules and manager flows (B39).

simplest_lawful_version: Two a-melding fields on the employment (arbeidstidsordning code, hours per week for a full-time position) with an employer default (e.g. 37.5, ikkeSkift). No limit profiles, averaging, § 10-12 flags or flex agreements.
reason: The a-melding requires both fields for every employment; the 32-field entity is over-engineering.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: standard Mon-Fri week from the national calendar x position %.
reason: Needed for part-time AGP per planned day, holiday in hours and § 10-7; target pilots have no turnus.
Shift/HR-system feature (SD Worx Team Planning).

name_en: Daily time registration with project, activity and dimensions
name_no: Timeregistrering per dag med prosjekt, aktivitet og dimensjoner
reason: Own time module (B20); in M1 hours come by CSV.

name_en: Hours for hourly-paid and extra staff
simplest_lawful_version: CSV with one row per employee per work date (hours, pay type, optional project); stored as day lines and summed to pay lines; month-only totals rejected unless the source-retention question is answered yes. M0 only if Brutto's own company has an hourly employee; otherwise M1.
reason: Bokføringsforskriften § 5-6 as cited in R3 D-11: hours per day and total for the period must be documented.

name_en: Deviation registration for salaried staff against the schedule
reason: Time module; § 10-7 question to Arbeidstilsynet is open.
Brutto is not a time clock; shift systems deliver from-to times.

name_en: Hour types and mapping to pay types
simplest_lawful_version: Map source codes directly to lønnsart in the single mapping table (no separate hour-type catalogue); an unknown code holds the line. M0: CSV uses Brutto pay-type codes directly.
reason: Mapping is needed for any external time source; the hour-type entity duplicates lønnsart.
Time module; in M1 overtime hours arrive approved and are priced by F-KJO-09.
The aml. § 10-6 duty sits with the customer's time source while hours come from there; build with the own time module.
Averaging/shift control; no turnus customers in the target; time systems do this.
Needs clock times and shift context; the shift system's job.
The employer duty is met in the time source while Brutto only imports; required when the own time module ships.
Balance lives in the source; payout via a manual line at termination.
No payroll effect; time module.

name_en: Taking time off in lieu and flexi leave
reason: Time module.

name_en: Time bank and flexi in termination and accounts
name_no: Timebank og fleks i sluttoppgjør og regnskap
simplest_lawful_version: M1: manual pay line at termination; negative flex deduction only with written agreement (aml. § 14-15).
reason: Rare; the manual route is lawful.

name_en: Evening, night, weekend and public-holiday supplements
name_no: Tillegg for kveld, natt, helg og helligdag
reason: Tariff/clock-window engine; sources send supplements as hour codes mapped to pay types.

simplest_lawful_version: Approved hour lines become pay lines (hours x rate from employment/pay type) with earning period and optional dimension. Merge with F-KJO-09.
reason: Hourly pay must be priced and reported with the right period.

simplest_lawful_version: Imported batch counts as approved (source approval + importing user recorded); lines lock with the payroll run; late lines go to the next period. No per-line manager approval in Brutto.
reason: Payroll must never pay unapproved time; the approval UI belongs to the time module.

simplest_lawful_version: Delta lines with the original work date in the next run; negative corrections held for written agreement (aml. § 14-15). Full-state diff later.
reason: Late hour corrections are routine for hourly staff.

name_en: Import from shift and rota systems
simplest_lawful_version: Generic CSV template only (preview, file hash, idempotent per line, employee-match error list). Planday, Tamigo, Quinyx, GAT and Tidsbanken connectors when a pilot requires one.
reason: CSV covers pilots at low cost (B42).

name_en: Consistency check between hours, absence and sources
name_no: Konsistenskontroll mellom timer, fravær og kilder
simplest_lawful_version: One check only: hours on a day with 100% absence (warning).
reason: Prevents double pay for hourly staff who are paid AGP; the other checks need multiple sources.
One source per data type in M1.

name_en: Project hours and cost allocation from hours
simplest_lawful_version: M1: fixed cost allocation per employment (ORG/REG).
reason: Valuable for project-funded foundations after the MVP.

name_en: Monthly timesheet signed by employee and manager
name_no: Månedlig timeark signert av ansatt og leder
reason: EU/Forskningsrådet niche; build when a research-funded customer pays for it.
Funder-specific rate models; a report on demand later.

name_en: Intake contract for expense and travel lines
simplest_lawful_version: One CSV/API line format for reportable lines only: MILEAGE, PER_DIEM, NIGHT_ALLOWANCE, BENEFIT_PRIVATE_COST, TRAVEL_TAXABLE_OTHER. Fields: person, date range, type, quantity (km/days/nights), gross amount NOK, meals covered (per diem), reiseregningKomplett attestation, private-benefit flag (required), approver, source claim reference. Full per-type travel facts (JSON schema) later. Utleggsappen uses the same format once its contract is agreed.
reason: B32: lines only via integrations; minimal fields let the kernel split and code correctly.

simplest_lawful_version: Reuse generic payroll-input idempotency (F-KJO-03): externalId + revision + file hash. Cross-source receipt-hash duplicate detection later.
reason: Double-payment guard is needed; cross-source dedup only matters with several sources.

name_en: Per-customer setup and link to employment
name_no: Oppsett per kunde og tilknytning til arbeidsforhold
simplest_lawful_version: Link by employee number only, otherwise a manual link queue; one setting: incomplete travel claim -> HOLD (default) or TAXABLE. No amount limits, run frequency, or account/VAT per category.
reason: Linking is mandatory; the rest of D-Utleggsoppsett is configuration nobody needs yet. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

simplest_lawful_version: Held-lines list with release/reject and reason; status readable via API and CSV export (no push to source).
reason: Lines with a missing link, mapping or approval must be stopped, not guessed.

simplest_lawful_version: CSV import is the first client; export of line status and classification. No historical import from Tripletex, ReAi or Visma Expense (YTD pay lines cover reporting).
reason: The CSV fallback makes M1 independent of the Utleggsappen contract.

simplest_lawful_version: Lines after cut-off go to the next period; a new revision produces delta lines; a negative delta is held (aml. § 14-15). Reclassification handled manually (reverse + new line).
