reason: Legal guard on deductions; reclassification automation later. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

simplest_lawful_version: M1: status via API read and CSV export.
reason: Push events matter once the Utleggsappen integration is live.
One source in M1.

simplest_lawful_version: Only Skatteetaten's domestic tax-free (trekkfri) rates: km car and passenger, per diem 6-12 h, over 12 h, overnight hotel with/without breakfast, night allowance, meal-deduction percentages; valid-from/to and expert sign-off. No state agreement (særavtale) or customer policy tables: the paid amount comes from the source.
reason: The split needs only the tax-free ceiling; the paid rate is the source's business. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

simplest_lawful_version: Car + passenger supplement only: tax-free = km x trekkfri rate, excess taxable with AGA. Trailer, forest road, boat and MC later; fixed car allowance via an ordinary taxable pay type.
reason: Most common allowance; the split is legally required. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

name_en: Per diem with and without overnight stay
simplest_lawful_version: Domestic only: tax-free ceiling = days x rate minus meal deductions; excess taxable. Over-28-days and commuter rules later.
reason: Common for organisations; split and codes are a legal must. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

simplest_lawful_version: Domestic undocumented night allowance only; lodging types (bedsit, barracks, caravan) later.
reason: Simple rate x nights. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

name_en: Completeness check of the travel claim
simplest_lawful_version: Trust a per-line reiseregningKomplett attestation from the source plus presence of quantity and dates; false or missing -> hold (default) or whole amount taxable. Field-by-field check of purpose, route and passengers later.
reason: Skattebetalingsforskriften § 5-6-12 consequence must be applied; the travel claim itself stays in the source. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

simplest_lawful_version: Domestic codes for km, per diem (hotel/no overnight), night allowance and taxable reiseKost/reiseAnnet/fastBilgodtgjoerelse, with antall. Pendler and foreign codes later. Pending Skatteetaten answer on the km field.
reason: Reporting duty; a wrong code gives a-melding errors.
Country rates and FX are not needed for typical pilots.

name_en: Rate lookup and dry-run for sources
reason: Integration convenience; useful when the Utleggsappen contract is built.

name_en: Private cost covered as a benefit
simplest_lawful_version: Flag -> taxable benefit pay type with AGA; no category cross-check.
reason: Employer-covered private cost is taxable. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Travel-allowance calculation cut from M1: M1 takes pre-split lines (taxable, tax-free, a-melding code, completeness flag) via PayInput (B32).

name_en: Refund via payroll or outside payroll
name_no: Refusjon via lønn eller utenfor lønn
simplest_lawful_version: Only reportable lines go through Brutto; pure receipt refunds are paid by the expense app or accounting (route B) until FL8 is settled.
reason: Keeps receipt archive and VAT out of payroll.
Extra runs exist in KJO; a scheduled weekly expense run is a convenience.
'Could'; handled in the expense app or accounting.

name_en: Expenses for non-employees who only receive allowances
name_no: Utlegg for ikke-ansatte og mottakere med bare utgiftsgodtgjørelse
simplest_lawful_version: Becomes M1 if a pilot organisation pays volunteers' or board members' travel via payroll (follows the ORL decision).
reason: Needs a recipient class without employment in the a-melding (ORL).

simplest_lawful_version: M1: line carries the source claim reference only.
reason: Pure refunds stay outside Brutto in M1; documentation stays in the source.
Brutto never posts VAT; the expense app or accounting owns VAT (proposed answer to FL8).

simplest_lawful_version: Account from pay type; dimension from the source via mapping, else the employment's cost allocation; reuse REG posting.
reason: The voucher must post allowances correctly.

name_en: Reconciliation of expenses between accounts and a-melding
name_no: Avstemming av utlegg mellom regnskap og a-melding
reason: Report after M1.

name_en: Vendor setup: Maskinporten client, keys and system register
simplest_lawful_version: Start the paperwork in M0 week 1 (7-10 weeks best case, 3-5 months estimated). One Maskinporten client per environment, own JWK key in a Norwegian KMS, yearly manual rotation with calendar alarm, system-register entry kept by a script. No HSM auto-rotation, no self-service API, no virksomhetssertifikat.
reason: Prerequisite for every API call in M1. Not needed to build M0, but the vendor orgnr is baked into the Altinn system id (M02), so the clock must start now.

name_en: System-user setup wizard for direct customers
simplest_lawful_version: API call that creates the system-user request with a-ordning + lonn only (no lonn-personopplysninger-saerlig-kategori, no krav-og-utlegg), returns confirmUrl, polls to Accepted, one ping test. No Brreg DAGL display, no case engine.
reason: Every direct pilot must approve a system user before Brutto can submit or fetch tax cards. M0 (own company) submits by manual upload.

simplest_lawful_version: Until then, issue a new system-user request if a package is missing.
reason: Only needed when NAV APIs or Krav og betalinger are switched on. M1 requests its packages up front.

name_en: System user for client systems (accounting-firm agent)
simplest_lawful_version: One agent system user per firm with regnskapsforer-lonn, client orgnr per call, calls serialised per firm (well below 5 concurrent). Fallback: standard system user per client approved by the client's DAGL.
reason: Needed for the 1-2 accounting-firm pilots. Firm still needs a written mandate from each client (GRFS 3.4); Altinn delegation alone is not enough. [Plan v1: accounting-firm features move to M2 (B45).]

name_en: Client linking and access diagnosis per client
simplest_lawful_version: Firm links clients in the Altinn portal (no client-delegation API). Brutto checks the REGN role in Brreg and the GET clients list and shows linked / not linked with one fixed instruction text.
reason: Unverified linking makes submissions fail. The client-delegation API needs an ID-porten client a private vendor may not get (open question). [Plan v1: accounting-firm features move to M2 (B45).]

simplest_lawful_version: Token/ping check right before each submission or fetch plus one daily check. 401, 403 and MP-303 become one case type. No per-service status matrix.
reason: A revoked system user must be detected early enough to use the manual fallback before the 5th. A nightly 9-service matrix is over-engineering for a handful of customers.

name_en: A-melding aggregate per reporting entity (opplysningspliktig) and month
simplest_lawful_version: One opplysningspliktig and one virksomhet (sub-unit); ordinary employments incl. those without pay; income lines; forskuddstrekk per lønnsutbetalingsdato; AGA per zone and beregningskode; pensjonsinnretning. Serialise to JSON per the OpenAPI schema (2.3). Utleggstrekk and refund deduction in M1; finansskatt CUT; bagatellmessig støtte only if zone Ia.
reason: The statutory monthly report (a-opplysningsloven) and the core output of a payroll month.

name_en: OTP and pension scheme (pensjonsinnretning) via the a-melding
simplest_lawful_version: M0: static pensjonsinnretning identifier per entity, correct pension-basis flags and stillingsprosent. M1: case when scheme or premium is missing.
reason: OTP-liable private employers must report pensjonsinnretning or get an avvik. OTP providers read the a-ordning, so this field is the whole integration.

name_en: Multiple runs per month and replacement message
name_no: Flere kjøringer i måneden og erstatningsmelding
simplest_lawful_version: Each new approved run or fix produces a full new version with erstatterMeldingsId = last accepted meldingsId; one message per entity and month. Diff view and the receipt for removed recipients LATER.
reason: Corrections are certain in the first months. A partial replacement silently deletes data at Skatteetaten (B §2.4). F532 from period 2027-01 favours the one-message strategy.

name_en: Pre-validation against business rules and code lists
simplest_lawful_version: M0: JSON-schema validation plus ~10 hard checks (sums equal lines, required fields incl. yrkeskode, F532 non-negative trekk per date). M1: the avvisning/oeyeblikkelig rules relevant to the M1 profile, kept as data. Full rule pack and text catalogue LATER.
reason: Rejected or 'øyeblikkelig' avvik risk tvangsmulkt (coercive fines). Skatteetaten validates anyway, so local validation can start thin.

name_en: Approval with hash lock and shared submission log
name_no: Godkjenning med hash-lås og felles innsendingslogg
simplest_lawful_version: M0: approver and SHA-256 of the payload stored at approval; payload immutable; manual upload logged with time and Altinn reference. M1: BankID step-up, preparer differs from approver with the logged small-customer exception (R3 D-47); agent may submit only a hash-matching payload (B41).
reason: Founder decision B41/J05: a human approves and the hash locks the a-melding. Cheap if designed in from day one.

name_en: Submission via REST or file-upload API
simplest_lawful_version: REST POST /v1/innsending only, idempotencyKey reused on retry, exponential backoff, AMLD_019 means fetch status. File-upload API (>10 MB) CUT for the 20-150 employee profile.
reason: Production API needs Maskinporten + system user (not realistic before Q1 2027). M0 uses manual upload.

name_en: Accounting firm: send all that are ready
name_no: Byrå: send alle som er klare
simplest_lawful_version: M1 firms submit per client.
reason: Batch convenience for firms with many clients. 1-2 pilot firms with simple clients do not need it.

simplest_lawful_version: Export the a-melding for Skatteetaten's manual upload. Format for 2027 periods: JSON per Skatteetaten Q&A 18.06.2026 [verify by 27.11]; an XML 2.3 serialiser of the same aggregate is a costed fallback (+1-2 weeks). Validate a synthetic twin in Skatteetaten's test upload with TestID (never real data). The uploader needs the A-ordningen package in Altinn 3.
reason: The only lawful submission route for M0 before Maskinporten/system user is ready, and the M1 contingency. Wrongly marked Etter MVP.

simplest_lawful_version: Poll the feedback using dialogId/forsendelseId from Leveransebekreftelse (consumerType Api) until available; store raw JSON. No Altinn Events subscriptions (LATER). M0: read the feedback in the Altinn inbox and record status by hand.
reason: Receipt status, avvik and AGA KID come only from the feedback. Polling avoids per-client event subscriptions (N25, N27).

simplest_lawful_version: Show Skatteetaten's own avvik name and severity per level, mapped to the employee; avvisning and oeyeblikkelig become cases; retningslinje requires a comment. No own text catalogue, no auto-close.
reason: Customers must follow up avvik. A curated plain-text catalogue costs payroll-domain hours the team does not have.

simplest_lawful_version: Read AGA KID, account and due date for the AGA term; compare the forskuddstrekk KID with Brutto's self-computed KID and raise a case if they differ. M0: read in Altinn by hand.
reason: AGA KID only comes via the feedback. A wrong KID means an unregistered payment.

simplest_lawful_version: Reporting correction = new full version of the old month from the stored aggregate. Economic correction = correction run in the payout month (KJO). Net/gross method for overpayment handled manually with guidance. No import of old-system content (LATER, MIG).
reason: Errors in earlier months must be corrected (up to 3 years). Pilots will need it within months.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: compute and show the dates for each run: a-melding 5th (next working day), forskuddstrekk first working day after payout (pay on payout day), AGA term 15th. No generic deadline entity, no notifications. M1: simple list and e-mail reminder.
reason: Missed deadlines mean tvangsmulkt or a punishable late trekk payment. A computed list is enough for one company.

simplest_lawful_version: Dated item for own payroll: 2.4 serialiser from the same aggregate, mapping by 1.7.2027, accepted in the 2.4 test environment by 1.12.2027; own company submits 2028-01 in 2.4 before any pilot.
reason: Mandatory but dated after M1. 2.4 content is not final, so code written now would be wasted. Hard date: in production by 1.12.2027. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Mandatory from period 2028-01 for our own payroll, so it cannot wait until after M1.

simplest_lawful_version: On demand and once after the 5th: order, poll to KLAR, compare per person income per description, forskuddstrekk and AGA per zone with Brutto; show sumInntekterMedFeil. Ledger link stays in REG. M0: download A07 from the portal by hand if needed.
reason: Truth source for migrating year-to-date balances and verifying parallel runs (brief). Same scope as submission.

simplest_lawful_version: One case list merged with D-Avvik; about 8 case codes; owner and due date; e-mail to the customer for blocking cases. No employee notifications.
reason: Customers need one place to see failed or rejected submissions. Two queues are over-engineering.

simplest_lawful_version: One HTTP client module: token cache, correlation id, idempotency, retries only for idempotent calls, call-log table without fnr or amounts, raw request/response encrypted in Postgres in Norway. No WORM hash chain, no separate agent allowlist service (use API permissions).
reason: Needed for any API traffic and as evidence against tvangsmulkt. WORM and hash chain can come with ISAE/ISO work.

simplest_lawful_version: Process, not code: a named owner subscribes to Skatteetaten SBS news/RSS, status page and NAV channels and reviews monthly. No SwaggerHub polling, no in-app banner.
reason: Vendor terms require following news and status (B §2.9). Automation not needed at this scale.

simplest_lawful_version: Fold the one essential check (sumInntekterMedFeil, recipients in A07 but not in Brutto) into F-MYN-21.
reason: Built for the old read-only phase 1. When payroll runs in Brutto, Skatteetaten's feedback catches most of these.

simplest_lawful_version: Human-triggered order on new employment or missing card with HENT_ALLE_OPPGITTE_OG_ENDRINGER; poll at least 2 s apart; store as a new tax-card version. No system rules, no agent trigger. M0: tax-card fields keyed by hand from Skatteetaten's portal or the old system.
reason: Withholding must use the current tax card. The API needs a system user, so M0 stays manual for 10 people or fewer.

name_en: Daily tax-card changes and freeze rule
simplest_lawful_version: HENT_KUN_ENDRING per employer right before calculation and before approval (daily job optional). A newer card before approval forces recalculation; after approval it applies from the next run. Poll-only from 15.12.2026.
reason: The employer must withhold by the latest card. A pre-run fetch covers it without a polling budget.

name_en: Tax cards for the new income year
simplest_lawful_version: Same order as F-MYN-25 with next inntektsaar in December; block January approval until cards are fetched or 'missing' is confirmed. No cross-client batch queue. M0: 2027 cards keyed by hand in December 2026.
reason: Needed the first December a pilot is live (Dec 2027). The new year's card is a legal requirement.

name_en: Fetch garnishment orders (trekkpålegg), notify and acknowledge
name_no: Henting av trekkpålegg, varsel og kvittering
simplest_lawful_version: M1: register orders by hand from the Altinn letter in TRK, with four-eyes, KID and account. Apply for API access once pilots have submitted via the a-melding API (test summary and signed agreement required).
reason: API access requires a-melding sent through Brutto's API first. A manual register is lawful at low volume.

name_en: Notice when a deduction cannot be made
name_no: Melding når trekk ikke kan gjennomføres
simplest_lawful_version: M1: warning when the deducted amount is below the order; the payroll officer contacts Innkrevingsmyndigheten by hand.
reason: No electronic channel exists. It is a manual duty outside the system.

name_en: Request for inntektsmelding (income report) from NAV
simplest_lawful_version: M1: the customer handles requests in NAV's own portal.
reason: B42 already makes NAV inntektsmelding manual. Needs the special-category access package and NAV onboarding.

name_en: Inntektsmelding for sick pay via API
simplest_lawful_version: M1: printable employer period (arbeidsgiverperiode) and 3-month average income per case (FRA) for manual entry in NAV's portal.
reason: Separate NAV onboarding and GDPR art. 9 data. Target the first operating year after M1.

name_en: Inntektsmelding for parental, pregnancy and family-sickness benefits
name_no: Inntektsmelding for foreldre- og svangerskapspenger og sykdom i familien
simplest_lawful_version: Manual in NAV's portal.
reason: NAV states only sick pay can be sent from payroll systems (11.6.2026); API status unclear.

name_en: Sick notes and sick-pay applications to employer
simplest_lawful_version: Employers see them in NAV's 'Dine sykmeldte'.
reason: Health data with high privacy cost; not needed to run payroll.

name_en: K27: fetch and import NAV refund settlement report
name_no: K27: henting og import av oppgjørsrapport for refusjon
simplest_lawful_version: CSV upload only, no API. Parse in memory, check orgnr and line sum, persist only the refund sum per sub-unit and month plus the file hash; do not store fnr/ytelseskode lines. API (nav:utbetaling/oppgjorsrapporter) LATER.
reason: M1 includes sick-leave basics; NAV refunds must reduce the AGA basis exactly once. Storing lines would add art. 9 data. Wrongly marked Etter MVP for the simplified version. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] K27 import cut from M1: refund receivable entered by hand (PLAN rule 3).

simplest_lawful_version: M1 supports only the 'deduct on receipt' AGA method driven by the K27 sum, which cannot double-deduct. Per-employee ledger and dunning list LATER.
reason: Per-employee matching needs the absence core and inntektsmelding; high domain effort.

simplest_lawful_version: One PDF per employee from accumulators: income per description, forskuddstrekk, deductions, feriepengegrunnlag; delivered through Digipost (M1 payslip channel) or by hand by 31.1. Own payroll: the 2027 statement by 14.1.2028 (M0+ track, gate AS27). The current system issues the 2026 statement (B44).
reason: Ferieloven § 10 requires the holiday-pay basis in a statement. Due 31.1.2028 for 2027 pilots (legal basis and deadline for the full statement [verify]). Wrongly marked Etter MVP.

name_en: Pay-equity mapping (ARP) basis from payroll data
simplest_lawful_version: Customers export payroll data to their HR or ARP tool.
reason: Employer duty, not a payroll-system duty; gender is not an a-melding field. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Same trigger as F-RAP-23.

name_en: Data quality for SSB and NAV via the a-melding
name_no: Datakvalitet for SSB og NAV via a-meldingen
simplest_lawful_version: Mandatory fields (yrkeskode, stillingsprosent) are validated in F-MYN-10; plausibility checks later.
reason: Does not cause rejection. A nice-to-have quality layer.

simplest_lawful_version: One lookup at onboarding via the open API: entity, sub-units, municipality to AGA zone, roles (DAGL, REGN). No nightly sync. M0: enter entity and zone by hand.
reason: Avoids setup errors for pilots. Nightly sync is over-engineering for a few customers. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Brreg lookup cut from M1: legal entity and sub-units entered by hand for 3-5 pilots.

name_en: Krav og betalinger: payments against claims
name_no: Krav og betalinger: innbetalinger mot krav
simplest_lawful_version: M1: payment confirmation by hand (F-BET-13).
reason: Needs the krav-og-utlegg package (not available to firms with regnskapsforer-lonn) and prior API reporting.

name_en: Contingency when an authority or Brutto is down
name_no: Beredskap når myndighet eller Brutto er nede
simplest_lawful_version: A runbook, not code: manual JSON upload (F-MYN-14), manual tax-card entry, K27 CSV, manual garnishment register; downtime evidence = gateway call log; last approved payment file downloadable.
reason: A missed 5th costs tvangsmulkt. The fallbacks already exist from M0. Wrongly marked Etter MVP.

simplest_lawful_version: One proposal per approved run: net pay per employee as SALA. M0: forskuddstrekk is a separate payment order (not SALA) to Skatteetaten, no later than the first working day after payout, with the KID from the a-melding feedback (upload on payday). M1: Brutto computes the KID only after it reproduces every KID the current system used in 2026 [verify positions 18-19]; withholding and deductions as separate payments.
reason: Skattetrekkskonto abolished from 1.1.2026: withholding is a separate payment after every payout.

name_en: Due-date calendar with working days and holidays
simplest_lawful_version: Norwegian holiday calendar incl. Easter. Payday on weekend/holiday moves to the previous working day; AGA 15th to the next. Pay forskuddstrekk on the payout date to sidestep the 24.12/31.12 question.
reason: Late forskuddstrekk is punishable. Paying the same day removes most edge cases.

simplest_lawful_version: Show AGA amount, KID and due date from the latest feedback and optionally a single-payment pain.001. Reconciliation gate as a warning, not a hard stop. Finansskatt CUT (not in the target segment).
reason: AGA must be paid by the 15th of each term. In M0 the customer pays from the Altinn information. Wrongly marked Etter MVP.
Dashboard nice-to-have; sums are on each proposal.

name_en: Deductions paid to creditors, unions and pension
name_no: Trekk til kreditorer, fagforening og pensjon
simplest_lawful_version: Payment lines for union dues and samordnet utleggstrekk (account and KID from the order, day after payout); small creditor register with four-eyes on the account. Bidrag and old-rules orders paid per letter by hand. Pension is not paid via Brutto (S #29).
reason: M1 includes union dues and basic deductions; samordnet trekk has a legal payment deadline. Wrongly marked Etter MVP.

name_no: Godkjenning av betalinger og harde sperrer
simplest_lawful_version: M0: no file before the run is approved; any change resets approval and proposal. M1: BankID step-up, preparer differs from approver (small-customer exception logged). Firm with payment mandate LATER.
reason: Core fraud control and founder rule (B41: a human confirms payments).

name_en: Instant payment and payout outside a run
simplest_lawful_version: Use an extra run and the normal file.
reason: Could-have; bank support for instant bulk varies.

simplest_lawful_version: pain.001.001.09 (Bits MIG 2.0) for the team's own bank: net pay in one PmtInf with CtgyPurp SALA; forskuddstrekk in a separate PmtInf without SALA with KID as structured SCOR reference; unique MsgId and EndToEndId. Per-bank profiles for 2-3 pilot banks in M1.
reason: B12: Brutto never moves money. A file works with every bank.

name_en: File integrity and handover to online bank
simplest_lawful_version: Show count, control sum and SHA-256; store the file at approval; log downloads; one active file per proposal.
reason: Mitigates file tampering between Brutto and the bank (R3 D-46) at near-zero cost.

name_en: Bank channel via multibank or accounting-system bank module
name_no: Bankkanal via multibank eller regnskapssystemets bankmodul
reason: Should-have convenience; superseded by the open-banking decision (B40).

name_en: Direct bank API and PSD2 limits
reason: Per-bank agreements and weak PSD2 bulk support; B40 and N09 choose one partner instead.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: customer pays foreign accounts by hand and confirms in Brutto.
reason: Rare in the M1 profile; needs IBAN/BIC, purpose codes and AML flags.

simplest_lawful_version: Keep the payment model channel-neutral now. ZTL first, Aritma as alternative (N09).
reason: B40 is partly decided but no provider is chosen; licence and client-funds questions (N17) need a lawyer.

simplest_lawful_version: Statuses proposed, approved, file created, confirmed paid (by hand, with date), returned. No bank messages, no events.
reason: B43: a file is never proof of payment, and the a-melding needs the actual payout date.
Manual confirmation is enough at M1 volume.
Automatic paid-confirmation and K27 bank matching are conveniences.

simplest_lawful_version: Mark a line returned by hand; after a four-eyes account fix, create one new payment line (new EndToEndId) through the same approval.
reason: Closed or wrong accounts happen in every pilot; without it re-payment happens outside the audit trail. Wrongly marked Etter MVP.

name_en: Confirmed payment date before a-melding and trekk due date
name_no: Bekreftet betalingsdato før a-melding og trekkforfall
simplest_lawful_version: Before the a-melding is generated, the user confirms the actual payout date (default = planned). A change updates lønnsutbetalingsdato and the trekk due date. T+1 reminder in M1.
reason: Lønnsutbetalingsdato in the a-melding must equal the actual payout and drives the trekk deadline.

simplest_lawful_version: Account change needs a second person's approval (or employee BankID once the M1 portal exists); encrypted, reads logged; changes since the last run listed on the proposal. Quarantine, old-channel notice and 12-month reconfirmation LATER.
reason: Account fraud is the main payroll fraud vector; founder rule that a human confirms account changes.

name_en: First payment to a new account
simplest_lawful_version: Flag the first payment to each new account; approver must differ from the person who verified the account, with a logged small-customer exception.
reason: S #24. A team of three in M0 cannot meaningfully separate these duties.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: net sum = run net; trekk sum per date = a-melding per date; no zero or negative net; same account on two employees blocks; KID MOD11 valid; debit account belongs to the employer. Deceased, after-termination, threshold and foreign checks in M1.
reason: Cheap guardrails that catch the costly errors.

simplest_lawful_version: SALA on the net-pay block; only the payroll role sees lines. Aggregated confidential groups LATER.
reason: Keeps individual pay hidden from non-payroll bank users; trivial.

name_en: Sync chart of accounts and dimensions from the accounting system
name_no: Synk av kontoplan og dimensjoner fra regnskapssystemet
simplest_lawful_version: One-time import of chart of accounts and department/project lists via the single adapter or a CSV/SAF-T upload; check that mapped accounts exist and are active before each voucher transfer. No nightly sync, no grouping/SAF-T metadata. M0: Sjur's standard accounts seeded, no sync.
reason: Vouchers must hit valid accounts in the customer's ledger, but continuous sync is not needed at pilot volume. Duplicates F-ORG-15. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Dimension sync and cost reporting cut from M1: one flat department/project code on the employment, carried to voucher lines.

name_en: Standard posting from the founder's template
simplest_lawful_version: Seed table with Sjur's standard mapping (S #27) for the 26 standard pay types and the system posts (tax, trekk, AGA, holiday-pay accrual, AGA on holiday pay, net). Override debit/credit per pay type per legal entity with effective date and audit log. No template inheritance levels.
reason: No voucher without it. The 2930 counter-account convention (credit gross / debit trekk) must be confirmed by Sjur first (open REG question).
Only serves A07-vs-ledger reconciliation and analytics; posting does not need it and the ledger owns grouping codes (G B4). Two codes are still assumed (S #28).

simplest_lawful_version: M1 fallback: the firm copies Brutto's standard mapping to each client; chain locking is cut.
reason: 1-2 pilot firms with simple clients can configure per client. Versioned inheritance, preview and rollback are scale tooling.

simplest_lawful_version: One balanced voucher per run and legal entity, aggregated per account (plus department/project when used); separate AGA lines per zone and rate with the base in the line text; holiday-pay accrual; trekk on 2600/2610/2650/2690; one net line on 2930. Voucher date = payout date. Reference payrun:<id>:rev<n>. Payroll journal attached or linked. Delivered as file in M0, via one adapter in M1.
reason: Legal core: the run must be booked with a two-way audit trail to the journal (N02, N30: NBS 2 pt 4.7) and AGA-liable benefits must be visible per sats and sone (bokføringsforskriften § 3-1 (1) no. 9).

simplest_lawful_version: Generate at approval as PDF + CSV with the § 5-6 content per recipient and period; store its SHA-256 on the voucher; retain 5 years in Norway, never delete. Hourly staff: attach the approved timesheet with hours per day instead of modelling daily hours. Aggregated variant for non-payroll users LATER.
reason: Required by bokføringsforskriften § 5-6 (issued no later than when pay can be paid out) and bokføringsloven § 13 (5 years). Merge with F-RAP-09 and F-KJO-45 into one report.

name_en: Net pay aggregated on 2930 and employee sub-ledger
simplest_lawful_version: Net pay as one line on 2930 per run. No employee sub-ledger postings. Block negative net instead of booking a receivable; advances and loans are handled manually by the accountant.
reason: S #9 and N02: aggregated net is lawful and keeps individual pay out of the ledger. Sub-ledger lines only matter for advances/negative net, which the M0/M1 profile does not have.

name_en: Dimension inheritance and frozen posting per line
name_no: Dimensjonsarv og fryst kontering per linje
simplest_lawful_version: Department (and optional project) from the employment, one value per employment per run (100 %), applied to derived lines (AGA, holiday pay). Account + dimension stored on the pay line; frozen because approved runs are immutable (B6). No separate allocation entity, no mid-period split, no percentage allocation, no 6-level precedence.
reason: Pilots have few sub-units and need department/project on cost lines. The full engine (largest remainder, segment split, dimension combinations) waits for multi-allocation customers. Duplicates F-ORG-18 and F-LON-06. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Dimension sync and cost reporting cut from M1: one flat department/project code on the employment, carried to voucher lines.

name_en: Vouchers for payment of net pay, withholdings and AGA
name_no: Bilag for betaling av lønn, trekk og AGA
reason: The accounting system's bank reconciliation books payments; vouchers from Brutto risk double booking. Build only if a customer asks.

name_en: Reversal, new revision and locked period
name_no: Reversering, ny revisjon og låst periode
simplest_lawful_version: From M0 (free with F-REG-05): corrections are new correction runs with their own voucher referencing the original. M1 adds automatic reversal through the adapter when a run is reopened before payment, and a manual date override when the ledger period is locked.
reason: Transferred vouchers must never change and revisions must never double-book. Automatic next-open-period suggestions are a nicety.

name_en: Holiday-pay accrual and AGA on holiday pay
name_no: Avsetning for feriepenger og AGA av feriepenger
simplest_lawful_version: Every run posts holiday-pay basis of the run x agreed rate (10.2 or 12 %, +2.3 pp for 60+ up to 6G) to 5020/2940 and AGA on the accrual at the sub-unit's zone to 5405/2785; June and termination payouts debit 2940. Always per run (no monthly/annual option). Year-end true-up of 2785/2940 done manually by the accountant from the holiday-pay list.
reason: The holiday-pay liability must be in the balance sheet (accrual principle for AS) and the parallel run must match the old system to the øre. Options and automatic clearing of 2785 are not needed.

name_en: Accrual of in-arrears supplements and wage settlements
name_no: Periodisering av etterskuddsvise tillegg og lønnsoppgjør
reason: Needed for turnus/in-arrears supplements and 250+ customers (VK-33); outside the M1 pilot profile. The accountant can book a manual accrual at year-end.

name_en: Reallocation vouchers for retroactive cost-allocation changes
name_no: Omfordelingsbilag ved endret kostnadsfordeling bakover i tid
reason: Large-organisation and grant feature; R3 D-39 says it can wait. Keeping account + dimension per pay line keeps it possible. Duplicates F-ORG-19.

name_en: OTP pension from invoice and AGA on premium
name_no: OTP fra faktura og AGA av premie
simplest_lawful_version: Payroll posts nothing for OTP (premium booked from the invoice, S #29). Enter the premium per month/termin and sub-unit manually (single zone = no zone split), add it to the AGA base and the a-melding pension field, warn when an OTP customer has no premium for the termin. Import from the ledger LATER.
reason: AGA on pension premium is mandatory and must be in the a-melding; leaving it out under-reports AGA every termin. M0 because Brutto AS very likely has a mandatory OTP scheme (verify) and it is one manual number per termin; aligned with F-PEN-05/06 (M0 in the TRK/PEN review).

simplest_lawful_version: M1 fallback: the accountant books NAV refunds on 5800 when the K27 report or payment arrives.
reason: Booking a refund claim (1580/5800) is an accrual nicety, not a legal duty; the AGA method for refunds belongs to MYN (F-MYN-35). Account 1580 is still unverified.

simplest_lawful_version: Brutto AS's own 2026 year-end: done manually by the accountant using the holiday-pay list and journals.
reason: Needed before the pilots' first year-end (Dec 2027/Jan 2028). Reclassifying 2910 only matters with advances, which M1 excludes.

name_en: Common voucher contract and generic file
simplest_lawful_version: One internal voucher struct; export as CSV (UTF-8, semicolon) and JSON, plus GET /vouchers?payRun= in the API. Fields: account, dimensions, amount, text, date, period, reference. Events/webhooks (payroll.posting.ready.v1) LATER.
reason: The file is the M0 delivery and the permanent fallback for ledgers without an adapter or when API terms block an adapter (N40).

simplest_lawful_version: Build only after written clearance from Tripletex (N40 T1/T2/T11). Push the voucher with externalVoucherNumber and the journal attachment; resolve accounts/departments by number. Choose the one M1 adapter by the pilots' ledgers; if terms are refused or late, pilots import the generic file. Multi-client firm token LATER.
reason: The review's M1 definition allowed one adapter and Tripletex is the most common ledger, but its developer terms ban competing products and replacing its business logic (risk high), so it must not sit on the critical path.
Second adapter after written clearance ('strategic and commercial interests' clause, N40 P1/P2). The generic file covers PowerOffice until then.
Valuable for foundations with project accounting, but no public API terms (N40 X1). Build when a foundation customer needs it; file meanwhile.
Generic file covers Visma; no public API terms found. Build when a paying customer asks.
Fiken users are mostly below the 10-employee target; one concurrent API call and a broad competing-solution clause (N40 F1/F4). Generic file suffices.

simplest_lawful_version: Status per voucher (ready, sent, booked, failed) on the run's accounting track (B43); retry reuses the same external reference; errors shown as plain messages and fixed manually (mapping, date). M0: status 'exported' when the file is downloaded. Errors go to the single deviation list, no separate case model.
reason: Needed once an adapter pushes vouchers; the pay run must complete even if booking fails, and retries must never double-book.

name_en: Read from the accounting system: balances, postings, employees
name_no: Lesing fra regnskapssystemet: saldo, posteringer og ansatte
reason: Serves the A07-vs-ledger product line, not payroll. Exactly where Tripletex/PowerOffice terms bite (N40 T1-T7) and requires a balance engine that removes reversal pairs (N32).

simplest_lawful_version: M1 fallback: Brutto shows its own voucher totals per account and period plus booked status; the accountant compares with the ledger.
reason: When Brutto posts the voucher itself, differences only come from manual postings; the control belongs to the accountant's monthly close and needs ledger reads (F-REG-29).

simplest_lawful_version: Fetch A07 (or upload the Altinn download) and compare per opplysningspliktig/virksomhet: forskuddstrekk, AGA base and AGA per zone, and per person per lønnsbeskrivelse. Differences get a free-text explanation and reviewer; no difference-type taxonomy. M0: manual comparison of the Altinn A07 download with Brutto's a-melding totals.
reason: A07 is the vendor-neutral truth for migration, parallel run and checking Brutto's own a-meldings (B16). Merge with F-MYN-21 and F-MIG-17 into one comparison engine.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: payment confirmed manually in BET.
reason: Needs camt.054 or bank integration (B40, after MVP).

name_en: Monthly reconciliation package and AGA payment lock
simplest_lawful_version: M1 subset lives in F-RAP-15 (payroll vs a-melding vs voucher totals, reviewed by one named user). The hard AGA lock is cut and replaced by a deadline warning.

simplest_lawful_version: M1 needs no invitation: the BankID identity is matched to existing person records.

simplest_lawful_version: Byrå-lite: one flat firm entity linked to client tenants. No chain/office/team levels and no inheritance.

simplest_lawful_version: Client from organisation number via Brreg; minimal fields: responsible accountant (oppdragsansvarlig), who approves pay (customer or firm under authorisation), engagement-letter document reference. No practice-system import, bank cut-off or pricing fields.
reason: Regnskapsførerloven §§ 5-1 and 5-2 (responsible accountant, written engagement). [Plan v1: accounting-firm features move to M2 (B45).]

name_en: Firm roles and access per engagement
simplest_lawful_version: Three roles (payroll consultant, controller/responsible accountant, firm admin) granted per client with optional end date; personal BankID login. No SSO/SCIM.
reason: Confidentiality limited to assigned clients (regnskapsførerloven § 4-2) and personal login (GRFS 8.1). [Plan v1: accounting-firm features move to M2 (B45).]

simplest_lawful_version: M2. M1 uses plain role grants per client.

simplest_lawful_version: M2: one agent system user per firm with regnskapsforer-lonn, client orgnr per call. Before M2, a firm's own payroll runs as a direct customer (standard system user).
reason: Open Altinn questions (K4 #8; fase1 M09/M11) need TT02 testing and possibly a Digdir ID-porten client: external lead time. [Plan v1 review fix 29.10.2026.] Agent system user is M2 (B45).

simplest_lawful_version: M2. M1 stores the engagement letter and authorisations as documents on the client.

reason: Legal (bokføringsforskriften § 5-6). Merge F-RAP-09, F-REG-06 and F-KJO-45 into one function.

simplest_lawful_version: Net per recipient with masked account number and payout date; count and sum must equal the pain.001 file; flag new or changed account numbers since the last run. Payment-status columns come when BET tracks status.
reason: The main check that the payment file is right before the customer signs in the bank (R3 D-46). [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] M0: these totals are in the attestation summary (F-RAP-16) and the run export (F-RAP-04).

simplest_lawful_version: Per employee: basis earned last year (incl. migrated months), paid so far, basis this year to date, 60+ extra, accrued amount, with source (migrated or calculated); totals to compare with 2940 and 2785. NAV-refund holiday pay and advance-holiday columns LATER.
reason: Evidence for the accrual, Brutto AS's 2026 year-end and the June 2027 payout; needed to match the old system in the parallel run (R3 D-04). [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Holiday-pay list needed for June 2027 (gate JUN27, 14.5.2027), not for the January go-live.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: forskuddstrekk per employee (table/percentage) and the total with KID and due date (first business day after payout). M1: utleggstrekk per order with KID, union dues per union, pension deduction. Union lists at group level and protected-amount checks LATER.
reason: Withholding must be paid in full and on time; union dues and basic deductions are in the M1 profile. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] M0: these totals are in the attestation summary (F-RAP-16) and the run export (F-RAP-04).

name_en: AGA overview per sub-unit, zone and rate

simplest_lawful_version: About ten fixed controls with thresholds as data: gross/net change per employee vs last month, new/removed pay types, zero/negative net, pay after end date, missing or outdated tax card, new account numbers, large one-off amounts. Ledger, bank, OTP-vs-pension-base and K27 sections LATER.

simplest_lawful_version: One totals view/API response before approval: gross, net, forskuddstrekk, AGA per zone, holiday-pay accrual, pension, number of recipients, vs previous month (and vs the old system during the parallel run). Budget column cut.
reason: The approver must see what they approve; trivial to build. Duplicate of F-KJO-22 (marked MVP) - merge. Wrongly marked 'After MVP' here.

The target group is outside CSRD after Omnibus I; questionnaire answers can come from exports.

name_en: Payroll cost per dimension and project
simplest_lawful_version: Payroll cost per department/project from the posted lines, with AGA and holiday pay following the same single dimension value. No retro column, no Tikket feed.
reason: Organisations and foundations need department/project cost for grants and budgets; almost free once dimensions are on voucher lines. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Dimension sync and cost reporting cut from M1: one flat department/project code on the employment, carried to voucher lines.

name_en: Project pay and timesheets for grants
reason: Strong differentiator for foundations and research (D-praksis §6.4) but needs timesheets (TID) and verified funder rates.
Budgets live in the ledger or BI; only used for comparisons that are themselves nice-to-have.
Needs a simulation mode of the engine; not needed to run payroll.
Nice-to-have calculator; maybe a marketing tool later.
Tariffs and wage settlements are outside the MVP.
Duplicate of F-BET-04 (After MVP); due dates for trekk and AGA already live in deadlines and the payment proposal.

name_en: Public REST API used by Brutto's own modules
name_no: Offentlig REST-API som egne moduler også bruker
simplest_lawful_version: OpenAPI 3.1 generated from code (utoipa); the UI calls only public API operations; one /v1 surface. No public/internal build gate, swap test or reference integration yet.
reason: B41 API-first: the UI is a client of the same API, so it has to exist from the first commit; retrofitting is expensive.

name_en: Versioning, deprecation and payroll-season change freeze
simplest_lawful_version: /v1 path prefix, additive-only changes inside v1, CHANGELOG in the repo, no breaking deploys in Dec-Jan and June. Deprecation/Sunset headers and the 12-month policy LATER (when partners exist).
reason: Pilot customers' scripts and agents will call the API; a formal partner deprecation regime is premature.

name_en: Idempotency, batch, dry-run and machine-readable reason codes
simplest_lawful_version: Idempotency-Key on POSTs that create pay runs, imports and pay input; errors as problem+json (RFC 9457) with stable codes; dry-run only for imports and pay input; per-line status only on the pay-input batch.
reason: Retries from agents and CSV uploads must never create duplicate pay lines (double-payment risk). Not needed for 3 people in M0.

name_no: Like og publiserte grenser for kall
simplest_lawful_version: M1 hygiene only: one generic per-token limit in middleware returning 429. Published per-installation limits and queue quotas when partners or byrå volume arrive.
reason: No partners and low volume in M0/M1.

simplest_lawful_version: Auto-rendered OpenAPI reference + one quick-start page for API tokens/MCP + llms.txt. No guides, Postman/Bruno collection, equal-treatment declaration or reference integration (LATER).
reason: Pilots and their agents need reference docs; the full portal is ~3 developer-months + 1 writer-month (R2-okosystem §8).

simplest_lawful_version: Pilots use a test tenant in the test environment (fase1 H04) with Tenor synthetic data.
reason: Only valuable when external developers build integrations.
No partner catalogue; re-add when 3+ external integrators want catalogue listing.

simplest_lawful_version: M1 API/MCP clients authenticate as the user (OAuth 2.1 / personal tokens), see F-PLA-32.
reason: Partner app model is not needed without partners.

name_en: Per-customer app installation with access packages and consent
name_no: Installasjon per kunde med tilgangspakker og samtykke
reason: Partner-ecosystem feature; no third-party apps in M0/M1.

name_en: Accounting firm installs apps on behalf of a client
name_no: Byrå installerer på vegne av klient
reason: Depends on F-PLA-09.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: a user can list and revoke own API tokens/agent grants (part of F-PLA-32).
reason: No installations to manage before partners exist.

name_en: Shadow mode and amount limits for new installations
name_no: Skyggemodus og beløpsgrenser for nye installasjoner
reason: Relevant when external sources write pay input; plausibility limits can live in KJO controls.

name_en: Source-of-truth registry per data type and scope
simplest_lawful_version: M0/M1: Brutto is the only source; hard-coded rule that identity, bank account and tax card are written only through Brutto (D-41).
reason: R3 D-41: a simple ownership flag holds until external sources write data.

name_en: Planned source switch at period change
simplest_lawful_version: Keep bitemporal validity on facts (B6) so it can be added later.
reason: Needed for own absence/time modules or Huma replacement (2028+).

name_en: Pay input v2: common write contract for amounts and quantities
simplest_lawful_version: One pay-input endpoint + CSV upload (hours per day, one-off amounts) with ~5 states (received, held, in_run, locked, rejected); hold on NEEDS_MAPPING and on net deductions lacking a written agreement (aml. § 14-15); no status callbacks or full-state diffing. M0: the hourly employee's hours are entered via the API.
reason: M1 pilots have hourly staff and external time/expense tools; a generic CSV replaces named integrations.

name_en: Absence v1 contract for external sources
name_no: Fravær v1: kontrakt for fravær fra eksterne kilder
simplest_lawful_version: M1 absence is registered in Brutto by payroll staff (FRA).
reason: Only needed if a pilot has an external absence source (R2-okosystem §9.2).

simplest_lawful_version: Exact match on employee number in the CSV; unmatched lines rejected with a reason; no fuzzy matching, no link queue, no D-Personkobling.
reason: CSV pay input needs a deterministic link to the employee; never auto-create persons.

name_en: Mapping tables per source profile and tenant
simplest_lawful_version: One mapping table per source profile (D-Kildeprofil) for pay-type codes only; unknown codes block; CSV in/out; mapping id+version stored per line; one approver; no AI and no test-calculation gate.
reason: Matrix lesson: mapping must be per source and forward-only; needed for CSV pay input and migration.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: polling job-status endpoint (fase1 J06); webhooks deferred as J13 proposes.
reason: No subscribers in M0/M1.

name_en: Integration monitor and public status page
simplest_lawful_version: M1: per-import-job status and errors (D-Importjobb); optional hosted status page.
reason: Few sources; job status is enough.

name_en: Pay calendar and cut-off events for sources
simplest_lawful_version: The calendar is readable through the API anyway (F-PLA-01); events come with webhooks.
reason: No external sources to notify.

simplest_lawful_version: Trigger: a paying pilot on Huma (OK-183). Fallback: CSV/PAXml through the migration template (F-MIG-10).
reason: B21 critics: build when 2+ customers need it; Huma API terms unconfirmed.

name_en: Time and shift integrations (Planday, Tamigo, Quinyx, GAT ...)
simplest_lawful_version: M1 uses the generic CSV in F-PLA-15 with one line per day, which meets the daily-hours documentation rule for hourly staff (bokføringsforskriften § 5-6, D-11).
reason: Named adapters are breadth; the generic CSV covers pilots.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: taxable allowances via the pay-input CSV; pure reimbursements are paid by the expense tool outside payroll (B32).
reason: Utleggsappen has no public API; the contract design is premature.

simplest_lawful_version: Honoraria via the pay-input CSV if a pilot needs them.
reason: Organisation segment comes after the MVP; no verified APIs.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: posting voucher as a CSV file (net pay aggregated on 2930). M1: one push adapter chosen by the pilots + generic file/pull endpoint; other ERPs LATER.
reason: Every payroll must be booked; a file is the simplest lawful hand-off.

simplest_lawful_version: pain.001 file only (version per pilot bank), forskuddstrekk (withholding tax) as a separate payment with KID; no pain.002/camt.054, multibank or bank APIs in M0/M1 (B12; B40 LATER).
reason: Salary must be paid; Brutto never moves money.

simplest_lawful_version: OTP reporting via the a-melding belongs to PEN/MYN; the premium needed for AGA is entered manually in M1; KLP/SPK files LATER.
reason: M1 profile is contribution-based OTP without public-sector pension.

simplest_lawful_version: BankID via an OIDC broker (Criipto/Idura or Signicat) for login and step-up only. E-signing, Entra/Google/Okta SSO, SCIM and Vipps LATER.
reason: B41/J05: a human approves payroll with BankID; SSO only matters for 250+ employees and byrå chains.

simplest_lawful_version: LATER: generic digital-post and notification channels (e-Boks, Slack/Teams/SMS/ICS). Payslip delivery to Digipost is covered by F-POR-12 in M1.
reason: M1 has a read-only BankID payslip page (F-POR-01/08), so Digipost/digital post is not needed for a lawful channel. Review override 29.10.2026.
Kombo/Apideck/Merge and practice-system adapters only when a byrå pays for it.

name_en: Agent identity and agent access package
simplest_lawful_version: Agent acts with an agent token issued by a named human (no OAuth server in M1); the audit log records actor_type=agent and on_behalf_of; read vs draft scope only; agent tokens can never approve or confirm. No per-agent quotas or packages.
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP', but needed as soon as MCP write exists (B41); cheap only if it is in the auth model from the start (OK-140).

name_en: MCP server with the same coverage as the API
name_no: MCP-server med samme dekning som API-et
simplest_lawful_version: rmcp server; ~10 workflow tools + 2 generic tools that reach every public operation (parity by construction); off by default per tenant; FNR/account masked; no special categories (J10). Details belong to the API/MCP reviewer.
reason: Founder decision B41; not needed to run one payroll in M0.

name_en: Human confirmation of actions started via API or MCP
name_no: Bekreftelse av handlinger startet via API eller MCP
simplest_lawful_version: Agents may only create drafts/requests; a human confirms in Brutto's UI with BankID step-up; the response is pending_confirmation + link; no URL elicitation; the action list is fixed in code.
reason: Required companion to MCP write (B13, B41); in M0 humans act directly in the UI. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] In M1 agents cannot start actions with legal effect at all (human-only operations); the confirmation flow comes with agent submission after the DPIA.
B13/R3: no AI in production before the core is stable; not needed for any payroll.

simplest_lawful_version: Tenant status (pilot/active/terminated) + feature-flag table + MCP/AI opt-in flags; no price plans, modules or invoice recipient; pilots are invoiced manually.
reason: Gradual rollout and tenant opt-in are needed once external pilots exist.

simplest_lawful_version: Count payees per month with a query for pilot invoicing.
reason: Pricing unit is undecided (K6 question); volume is trivial.

name_en: Login with BankID, passkeys and SSO
name_no: Innlogging med BankID, passkeys og SSO
simplest_lawful_version: M0: managed OIDC login (e.g. Entra ID, since hosting is Azure) with MFA and a CLI device flow; personal accounts only. M1: BankID via broker for customer users and approvers. SSO/SAML LATER. [Byrå parts are M2 (B45).]
reason: Personal login with MFA is the GDPR art. 32 baseline and a GRFS 8.1 requirement for byrå (BY-34).

simplest_lawful_version: Only once employees log in. Manual fallback: payslip via Digipost/encrypted PDF; account change on a signed form with four eyes.
reason: M1 needs no employee login if payslips go via Digipost.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: re-authentication on pay-run approval and bank-account change via the IdP (max_age / prompt=login). M1: BankID step-up.
reason: Account change is the main fraud vector; approval integrity (B41: a human approves with BankID).

simplest_lawful_version: M1: manual deactivation by the customer admin.
reason: R3 B14 puts SCIM around 2029; pilots have few users.

simplest_lawful_version: Roles as code constants; no copying or narrowing. M0: payroll admin + approver. M1: ~6 roles (customer admin, payroll preparer, approver, read-only, byrå admin, byrå payroll staff) + a 'health & union' permission. [Byrå parts are M2 (B45).]
reason: Need-to-know (GDPR art. 5(1)(c), 32) without a configurable role engine.

name_no: Relasjoner og omfang (ReBAC), også for byrå
simplest_lawful_version: Two relations only: user-tenant role and byrå-client assignment-byrå user; the byrå console shows client metadata only. No org-unit, manager or delegation scopes. [Byrå parts are M2 (B45).]
reason: 1-2 byrå in M1 need client separation; manager/department scopes come with LED/POR. [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Byrå-client relation is M2 (B45); the user-tenant role is in F-SIK-05.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: a hard-coded list of sensitive fields drives masking and access logging. Do not store home addresses unless needed (avoids address-protection handling). Confidential groups when a 100+ employee customer asks.
reason: Generic ABAC is over-engineering for pilots.

name_en: Payroll access and special categories (health, union)
simplest_lawful_version: One 'payroll amounts' permission + one 'health & union' permission that unmasks sick-pay pay types, absence reasons and union-dues lines; net pay aggregated per run on 2930. M0: all users are payroll admins.
reason: GDPR art. 9 data appear in payroll lines; need-to-know is required once customers have several user types.

simplest_lawful_version: Until the first audit season (spring 2028) the customer exports reports for its auditor; then a read-only role with an expiry date.
reason: No auditor needs live access in M0/M1; cheap to add once roles exist.

simplest_lawful_version: NO CODE: no standing human access to production data; documented emergency procedure (named person, reason, cloud audit log, customer informed). In-product consent flow LATER.
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP', but processor confidentiality (art. 28(3)(b)) and the regnskapsførerloven boundary (D-35) apply from the first customer.

simplest_lawful_version: M0: tenant_id on every row from the first migration, and one application policy module. M1: Postgres RLS enabled before the first external customer, CI test for cross-tenant reads, external pentest. No cells.
reason: Catastrophic failure mode for multi-tenant payroll; cheap now, expensive to retrofit (B7, D03).

simplest_lawful_version: Block: preparer approves own run; a user changes own salary or bank account. Warn for the other combinations. M0 may apply preparer != approver by convention.
reason: Internal-control expectation (D-praksis §3.2, GRFS for byrå); not law, but cheap.

name_en: Exception for small customers with compensating control
name_no: Unntak for små kunder med kompenserende kontroll
simplest_lawful_version: Per-tenant 'single payroll person' toggle with a reason + named recipient who gets a post-run report of own-salary changes, new bank accounts and new employees.
reason: Many pilot organisations have one payroll person; F-SIK-12 would otherwise block them.

name_en: SoD report and periodic access review
simplest_lawful_version: Users/roles listing via the API until ISAE work starts.
reason: Auditor/ISAE expectation; not needed for pilots.

simplest_lawful_version: Append-only table from the first migration: actor, on-behalf-of, channel (cli/api/import/mcp/job), action, resource, before/after (masked for sensitive fields), time. Hash chain and daily seal LATER (ISAE).
reason: Traceability of the payroll basis (bokføringsloven) and integrity (art. 32); past changes cannot be logged retroactively.

simplest_lawful_version: Same log store: record unmask/full view of fødselsnummer (national ID) and bank account, exports and bulk reads (one row with count + file hash); not every list read.
reason: Founder rule S §2 pkt. 6; needed to answer what users and agents read once customers and MCP exist.

name_en: Log search and export (auditor, admin, SIEM)
name_no: Søk og eksport av logg for revisor og administrator
simplest_lawful_version: M1: a filterable audit-log endpoint in the API.
reason: SIEM export only matters for larger customers.

simplest_lawful_version: M1 hygiene: IdP/broker alerts on failed logins + cloud-native alerts.
reason: Pattern detection needs volume.

name_en: Field encryption, blind index and masking
simplest_lawful_version: M0: envelope encryption of national ID/D-number and bank account with one key (KEK in Key Vault in Norway), HMAC blind index for lookup, masked by default in API and CLI. M1: one data key per tenant, masked in MCP. Other data classes LATER.
reason: Not a legal requirement (art. 32 'as appropriate'), but founder rule S §2 pkt. 6 and agent access make it the M1 baseline. [Plan v1 review fix 29.10.2026.] PLAN E9: field encryption from the first migration.

simplest_lawful_version: Managed KMS in Norway, one DEK per tenant, documented rotation; crypto-shredding LATER (first deletions around 2032).
reason: Companion to F-SIK-19.

simplest_lawful_version: NO CODE in M1: retention policy (5 years after fiscal-year end; logs the same) in the DPA and the records of processing.
reason: The first lawful deletion falls around 2032; deleting too early is the bigger risk.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual deletion at contract end per the DPA.
reason: No data reaches the end of retention before about 2032.

simplest_lawful_version: M1: a one-page data map / sub-processor list annexed to the DPA (F-SIK-27).
reason: A document suffices with a handful of stores.
Moot if primary data and backup stay in Norway (B9); revisit only if a store moves abroad.

simplest_lawful_version: Managed Postgres in a Norwegian region with PITR + nightly encrypted logical dump to a second Norwegian location/provider; one documented restore test before the first live run. WORM, 13-month retention and DR drills LATER.
reason: Accounting material must be protected against loss (bokføringsloven § 13, forskriften § 7-2 per S §1 pkt. 5) and be restorable (art. 32(1)(c)).

name_en: Full export and archive on termination
name_no: Full eksport og arkiv ved opphør
simplest_lawful_version: M1: DPA clause + manual export via the API (payslip PDFs, a-meldinger, vouchers, YTD).
reason: No pilot leaves in the first months; the customer keeps its 5-year retention duty.

simplest_lawful_version: NO CODE: standard DPA based on EU SCC 2021/915 in two variants (direct customer; byrå with Brutto as sub-processor) + public sub-processor list. Not needed in M0 if the team's employer is the company that operates Brutto.
reason: GDPR art. 28: mandatory before processing any customer's data.

name_no: DPIA-mal og vurdering av særlige kategorier
simplest_lawful_version: M0 NO CODE: art. 30 record + 1-2 page risk assessment for own employees. M1: art. 30(2) processor record, a reference DPIA customers can reuse, and an external review of art. 9 handling and MCP agent access before the first pilot.
reason: Art. 30 applies (payroll is not occasional); a DPIA is likely for customers that enable agent access; the processor must assist (art. 28(3)(f)).

simplest_lawful_version: Short system description (bokføringsforskriften § 5-6) for the M0 employer, signed before the first live run; extended per customer in M1.
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP', but § 5-6 requires an easy-to-read description of the payroll system for every customer (B-myndigheter §10.2). [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Required from the first live month.

name_no: Innsyn, retting og dataportabilitet for registrerte
simplest_lawful_version: M1 manual: Brutto produces a per-person extract via the API on the customer's request within one month; template text for employee information (art. 13).
reason: Controller duty with processor assistance; low volume with pilots.

simplest_lawful_version: Hard-coded: agent tokens can never approve/confirm; MCP off by default per tenant; FNR/account masked; health/union never via MCP; Brutto's own assistant LATER. Rule from M0: coding agents never touch production data.
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP', but mandatory if MCP write is in M1 (B13, B41, J10).

name_en: Security package for procurement and attestations
simplest_lawful_version: NO CODE: 3-5 page security description, DPA, sub-processor list and contingency description. ISAE 3402 type 1 about 6 months after the first customer is live; type 2 and ISO 27001 LATER (B15).
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP', but pilots and byrå (GRFS) ask for it before signing.

simplest_lawful_version: M0 NO CODE: one-page breach and calculation-incident procedure (Brutto's company as controller notifies Datatilsynet within 72 h). M1: processor notifies the customer without undue delay (24 h in the DPA), templates. Tabletop drills LATER.
reason: GDPR art. 33/34 apply from the first employee record.

simplest_lawful_version: On approval, store the payment file and payslips in object storage, downloadable when the app is down; written 'Brutto down T-2' procedure. SLOs LATER. M0 fallback = the old system running in parallel.
reason: Employees must be paid on time even if Brutto fails.

name_en: Change management, release diff and payroll sign-off
simplest_lawful_version: Golden cases + recompute the previous month in CI before each release; Sjur signs calculation/reporting changes; cargo-audit/deny + secret scanning. Pentest before M1. Multi-tenant release diff on real data LATER.
reason: Main defence against plausible-but-wrong code from coding agents (B28, D-48).

simplest_lawful_version: NO CODE rule + Tenor synthetic persons for Altinn TT02. Order Skatteetaten trekkpålegg test data now (long lead time) for M1.
reason: Skatteetaten and NAV require synthetic test data; purpose limitation.

name_en: Migration project with phases and go/no-go
simplest_lawful_version: No project entity: 3-4 fields per opplysningspliktig (reporting entity): previous system, last period reported by the old system, first period reported by Brutto, old system readable until; they block reporting one period from two systems. Plus a written checklist and go/no-go note.
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP', but the 'never two systems for one period' rule (A-marked §7.1) applies from the first Brutto a-melding.
Bulk byrå waves (e.g. January 2028) come after the MVP.

name_en: Access to the source system and the A07 truth
simplest_lawful_version: M0: report exports from the old system + A07 (avstemmingsrapport, reconciliation report) for the last month ordered manually in Altinn. M1: A07 via MYN's API with system user; customer uploads exports. No API tokens to old systems.
reason: Marked 'Etter MVP', but arbeidsforhold-IDs and YTD must be verified against a-ordningen before the first submission.

simplest_lawful_version: One pipeline: CSV upload -> validate -> dry-run diff -> customer signs with step-up -> import with source reference; idempotent on file hash; rollback until used in an approved run; no AI. M0 seeds <=10 people via scripted API calls.
reason: Pilots need repeatable, signed imports; customer signing keeps Brutto outside regnskapsføring (D-35).

simplest_lawful_version: Only if 3+ pilots come from Tripletex and the API terms allow it (N40); the Excel template covers it meanwhile.
reason: The Tripletex API lacks fixed lines, deductions and tax cards anyway.

simplest_lawful_version: Only if a pilot comes from ReAi.
reason: The template covers it.
First to cut (R3 §2.5); field list not mapped.

name_en: Visma.net Payroll, Visma Lønn and Huldt & Lillevik import
name_no: Visma.net Payroll, Visma Lønn og Huldt & Lillevik
simplest_lawful_version: Exported reports go into the Excel template.
reason: Partner access uncertain; the template covers it.

name_en: SD Worx and other service-provider exports
simplest_lawful_version: Add an export checklist to the template documentation.
reason: Export by contract; the template covers it.

simplest_lawful_version: One template set using official a-melding code values; sheets: employees + arbeidsforhold (IDs, dates), leaves, YTD per inntektsbeskrivelse (income description), holiday-pay basis, fixed lines/benefits, trekkpålegg, OTP membership, open sick-leave cases. No AI column mapping.
reason: Universal fallback for all source systems (B16).

name_en: Import of submitted a-meldinger as truth
name_no: Import av innsendte a-meldinger som fasit
simplest_lawful_version: A07 + the template are truth enough for M0/M1.
reason: Reconstructing history from a-melding content is heavy (Matrix analysis).
Tied to the Huma connector and replacement.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual mapping table old code -> Brutto pay type, with target flags and a-melding code shown; a payroll professional approves. The AI-suggestion part is CUT.
reason: Pay-type flags are a top first-year error source (R3 b.0 nr. 2); AI adds little at pilot volume.

name_en: Code-list mapping with 'unknown' as a stop
name_no: Mapping av kodelister med «ukjent» som stopp
simplest_lawful_version: The template requires official a-melding code values; blank/invalid = unknown and blocks that arbeidsforhold; no per-source code tables.
reason: Default values would create false a-melding data.

simplest_lawful_version: FNR/D-number and orgnr mod11, STYRK from a local list, percentage, date order, row totals vs source control totals. Online Brreg/SSB lookups optional.
reason: Cheap checks that stop most migration errors.

simplest_lawful_version: Manual entry (M0) / template (M1) of arbeidsforhold-ID (employment ID), start date, type, last salary-change date and last %-change date from A07/old system, never the import date; permisjons-IDs kept.
reason: LEGAL: wrong IDs create duplicate employments in Aa-registeret and false change dates in the a-melding (Skatteetaten guidance on changing payroll system).

name_en: Reconcile against A07 before the first a-melding
name_no: Avstemming mot avstemmingsrapporten før første a-melding
simplest_lawful_version: M0: manual side-by-side check for <=10 people. M1: automated diff via MYN's A07 fetch; must be 0.
reason: Last safety net before the first submission (B16).

name_en: Transition rules for pay in arrears
simplest_lawful_version: Earning-period field on pay-input lines + cutover rule in the checklist (which system pays variable pay earned before cutover); block the same earning period from two sources. M0: decided manually.
reason: High January risk for pilots with hourly/overtime pay (R3 b.0 nr. 3).

name_no: Retting av perioder fra før overgangen
simplest_lawful_version: NO CODE in M1: the pilot contract keeps the old system usable for at least 3 months for corrections.
reason: Replacement a-meldinger for old periods need the whole month's content.

name_en: Annual summary (sammenstilling) after a mid-year switch
name_no: Sammenstilling ved bytte midt i året
simplest_lawful_version: M1, for pilots that start mid-year: generate per employee from imported YTD per inntektsbeskrivelse plus Brutto's runs, by 31.1 of the next year. Not in M0: the current system submits all of 2026 (B44), so Brutto produces no 2026 annual summary.
reason: Ferieloven § 10 requires the holiday-pay basis in a summary to the employee; the annual-summary basis is otherwise unverified (D-36), so treat it as a legal duty. [Plan v1 review fix 29.10.2026.]

simplest_lawful_version: M1: YTD per inntektsbeskrivelse and forskuddstrekk per employee from an Excel template, checked against A07; AGA basis per sub-unit and zone, frikort used and OTP basis. Not needed in M0 because Brutto starts on 1.1.2027 (B44).
reason: Needed for the annual summary, frikort limits and zone 1a fribeløp, not for table withholding. [Plan v1 review fix 29.10.2026.]

name_no: Feriepengegrunnlag for fjoråret og inneværende år
simplest_lawful_version: Dated item for own payroll: 2026 holiday-pay base per employee from the current system's holiday-pay list, closed on payout dates up to 31.12.2026, checked against 2940; by 14.5.2027 (gate JUN27).
reason: LEGAL: feriepenger (holiday pay) paid in June 2027 and on termination depend on it (ferieloven). [Plan v1 after review 29.10.2026.] Needed by June 2027, not by the January go-live.

name_en: Holiday days, time off in lieu and care days
simplest_lawful_version: Kept in the customer's HR tool or spreadsheet until the FRA module.
reason: No M0/M1 pay calculation depends on day balances beyond the standard holiday deduction.

name_en: Ongoing sick leave and arbeidsgiverperiode (employer period)
simplest_lawful_version: Manual entry of open cases (start, grade, employer-period days used, refund-claim status); no import.

reason: Payroll documentation must be retained 5 years after year-end (bokføringsloven; S §1 pkt 1). The full HR file is the HR extension (B34).

reason: Neutral content protects art. 9 data; e-mail is enough for the payroll process.

name_en: Notification catalogue for the payroll process
simplest_lawful_version: Hard-coded ~7 events: run ready for approval; approved run without a-melding (task until receipt); a-melding feedback errors; tax card missing or changed; bank account changed; payslip available; deadlines for a-melding, forskuddstrekk and AGA. Not customer-configurable.
reason: Missing the a-melding or forskuddstrekk deadline has legal cost; a few fixed rows cover it.

reason: Matrix pattern: the state creates the task. Cheap and avoids a task engine.
